Austria Industrial Output Unchanged in June — Industrial production in Austria was unchanged in June 2026 from the same month a year earlier, following a flat reading in May. The industry sector continued to contract (-1.5% vs -0.7% in May), while construction activity grew at a faster pace (5.6% vs 3.1%). Among the main industrial groupings, consumer non-durables declined further (-7.0% vs -3.0%), while growth in intermediate goods slowed (0.5% vs 1.3%). Meanwhile, energy production fell at a softer pace (-4.6% vs -7.8%), whereas output for capital goods edged up (0.1% vs -0.7%) and consumer durables rose sharply (12.4% vs 9.6%). On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, industrial production rose by 0.5%, rebounding from a 0.3% fall in the previous month.

【Market pricing lifts September BOJ rate-hike odds to 66%; JGB yields rise】Investors, after release of the Bank of Japan’s policy meeting minutes, are increasingly focused on a faster-than-expected tightening path, boosting JGB yields on Monday. The 10-year JGB yield rose about 2.5bps to 2.810%; the 2-year hit a roughly 31-year high of 1.620%; the 5-year reached a record 2.090%. Totan Research and Totan ICAP show market-implied September rate-hike odds at 66% as of Monday afternoon, up from about 30% at month-end.

【日本日經225指數因人工智慧漲勢創近四周最高收盤價】日本日經指數週一上漲 逾2%，創下近四周來最高收盤價，受人工智慧和晶片相關股票推動，此前華爾街週五反彈，但對中東局勢的擔憂限制了整體漲幅。 日經225指數上漲 2.08%，收於 66970.22 點，創下自 7 月 15 日以來的最高收盤點位。更廣泛的東證指數上漲 0.63%，收於 4100.61 點。 大和證券高階策略師橋 Daisuke Hashizume表示："晶片相關股票的上漲支撐了日經指數。對美聯儲加息的預期減弱是推動因素。"晶片相關企業愛德萬測試和東京電子分別上漲 6.43%和 4.13%。藤倉上漲 7.62%，延續了上週五這家光纖電纜製造商上調年度淨利潤預期後的強勁漲勢。作為人工智慧風向標英偉達供應商的揖斐電上漲 4.03%。瑞可利控股 （Recruit Holdings）飆升 22.79%，觸及 16165 日元的單日漲停上限，此前這家人力資源服務公司上調的年度業績預測超出市場預期。優衣庫品牌所有者迅銷集團下跌 0.74%。 鋰離子電池材料製造商三井金屬礦業在修訂後的年度淨利潤預測未能達到市場預期後，股價暴跌 13.55%。

【澳洲國民銀行外匯策略師：美聯儲短期大機率維持觀望 保持利率不變】澳洲國民銀行外匯策略師認為，美國通脹環境依舊錯綜複雜，美聯儲短期大機率維持觀望，保持利率不變，繼續等待更多經濟訊號。
Hungary's prime minister said rising Danube water levels have allowed the Paks nuclear power plant to begin reverting one turbine to its original state.

【July IPO registration approvals hit highest monthly level this year】July saw a supply peak in China’s IPO market: 21 firms received registration approvals — the highest monthly tally year-to-date — with the Beijing Stock Exchange accounting for over half. The Sci‑Tech Innovation Board (STAR Market) approved four firms. On the issuance front, 20 IPOs began prospectus/bookbuilding in July, lifting aggregate fundraising to a year-to-date record; Changxin Technology raised 57.92 bln yuan, the largest A‑share IPO since the registration-based system was adopted.
Hang Seng Tech Index rose more than 1% at the close; Nio-SW (09866.HK) and Lenovo Group (00992.HK) led component gains. The Hang Seng Index traded up nearly 1%.

【日元貶值紅利釋放 日本企業出現上調業績潮】據報道，日元走弱正為日本跨國企業帶來顯著商業利好，許多企業在最新一輪財報季中上調了業績預期。儘管日本政府近期採取了干預措施，市場預計日元仍將承壓。因此，包括豐田汽車（Toyota Motor）、本田汽車（Honda Motor）、索尼（Sony）以及無印良品母公司株式會社良品計劃等海外業務佔比較高的企業，紛紛上調了業績展望。根據岡三證券報告，在東證指數約1600家成分股公司中，自7月1日以來，已有159家公司上調財年業績預期，僅12家公司下調預期。整體業績預期調整比例達到86%，為2016財年以來最高水平。

【Yen weakness sparks wave of earnings upgrades among Japanese exporters】Japanese media report the weaker yen is providing a material tailwind to multinational exporters, prompting a wave of fiscal-year earnings upgrades this reporting season. Despite recent government FX intervention, markets expect the yen to remain under pressure. Export-heavy firms including Toyota Motor, Honda Motor, Sony and Muji parent Ryohin Keikaku have raised profit outlooks. Okasan Securities says that among TOPIX’s roughly 1,600 constituents, since July 1, 159 firms have upgraded fiscal-year forecasts and 12 have cut them; the overall forecast-revision ratio reached 86%, the highest since FY2016.

【Ex-US Air Force secretary accused of disclosing Air Force One classified details; clearance revoked】Former US Air Force secretary Frank Kendall, a Democrat who served under President Biden, is accused of disclosing classified details about Air Force One to reporters and has had his security clearance revoked. In a recent interview Kendall said a Boeing 747 reportedly gifted by Qatar to current Republican President Donald Trump has security shortcomings; he said he was "surprised" the plane would be used outside the US, described the refit as rushed and questioned whether security features had been "maximized." Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell said on social media Kendall "unauthorizedly disclosed classified information" about Air Force One’s capabilities, and that Kendall’s access to classified information has been revoked and he is barred from sensitive positions.

【7月IPO註冊批文創年內單月新高】7月IPO市場迎來年內供給高峰，根據記者統計，在註冊端，共有21家IPO企業披露註冊批文，創下年內單月新高。其中北交所貢獻佔比過半；科創板保持年內相對較高的註冊節奏，當月共有4家獲批。在發行端，7月共有20家IPO企業啟動招股工作，在年內處於高位水平，合計募資規模重新整理年內紀錄。其中長鑫科技以579.19億元的實際募資額，成為註冊制以來A股最大IPO。（證券時報）

Slovakia Industrial Output Rebounds in June — Industrial production in Slovakia increased by 2.1% year-on-year in June 2026, defying expectations of a 0.6% fall, ending a four-month period of decline and marking the second increase this year. The recovery was supported by higher output in 10 of the 15 monitored industrial sectors, led by the manufacture of basic metals, which rose 6.6% and made the largest positive contribution to overall growth. Output also increased sharply in the manufacture of chemicals and chemical products (30.8%) and machinery and equipment n.e.c. (6.6%), while the manufacture of motor vehicles returned to growth after four months of decline, rising 1.7%. By contrast, the manufacture of computer, electronic and optical products fell 36.5%, making the largest negative contribution to industrial production. On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, industrial production decreased 0.7%. In the first half of 2026, industrial production declined 0.8% year-on-year.
【China government bond futures midday close】Most-active 2-year (TS) contract fell 0.01%, 5-year (TF) rose 0.02%, 10-year (T) rose 0.04% and 30-year (TL) rose 0.32%.

The Shangai Composite Index Closes 0.67% Higher — The Shangai Composite Index gained 27 points or 0.67 percent on Monday to close at 3967 points. Gains were led by Avic Shenyang Aircraft (5.97%), Shaanxi Coal (3.87%) and Kweichow Moutai (2.99%). Biggest losers were Sanan Optoelectron (-3.82%), China Life Insurance (-2.49%) and China Pacific Insu (-1.84%).
Japan 30-year bond yield rose 5 bps to 3.98%.

Turkey Industrial Output Falls the Most in 5 Months — Industrial production in Turkey dropped 1.4% year-on-year in June 2026, deepening from a revised 0.1% decline in May and marking the second consecutive month of contraction. It was also the steepest drop since January, as manufacturing output fell for the first time in three months (-1.5% vs 0.2%), weighed down by weaker production of tobacco products, wearing apparel, leather and related products, printing, and rubber and plastic products. Meanwhile, mining and quarrying activity continued to contract, although the pace of decline eased (-1.6% vs -5.5%). In contrast, electricity, gas, steam, and air-conditioning supply continued to expand, accelerating slightly to 1.1% from 1.0%. On a monthly basis, industrial production edged up 0.1%, reversing a revised 3.0% decline in May.

【上海期貨交易所：對2家公司、1名個人暫停開倉交易12個月】8月10日，上海期貨交易所釋出違規處理決定公告：經查明，2025年11月14日，張勇操作無錫名思匯智科技合夥企業（有限合夥）和海南慧定思網路科技有限責任公司在bu2602P2650合約實施事先約定的相互交易、轉移資金的行為。上述行為已構成《上海期貨交易所違規處理辦法》第三十二條第一款第三項規定的違規行為，依據該辦法第三十二條，本所決定：1.給予無錫名思匯智、海南慧定思、張勇通報批評處分。2.責令改正，給予無錫名思匯智、海南慧定思、張勇自收到違規處理決定書次日起暫停開倉交易12個月的處分。相關違規處罰決定記入證券期貨市場誠信檔案資料庫。
【京北方中標某金融資產登記交易機構新一代核心業務系統專案】據京北方公眾號訊息，京北方中標某金融資產登記交易機構新一代核心業務系統專案。該專案將圍繞金融資管產品全生命週期（登記、交易、存續管理、資訊披露）打造一體化平臺，重點實現三大目標：全面重構核心業務能力；築牢信創合規底座；重塑使用者體驗與管理效能。
愛立信於2026年8月3日至8月7日期間開展股票回購。
Ukrainian agricultural consultancy APK-Inform reported weekly exports of key Ukrainian grains fell 24% to 218,000 tonnes in the week Jul 30–Aug 5.

Iron Ore Slips as Global Shipments Rise — Iron ore futures declined to around CNY 711 per ton, resuming their downward trend after data showed global shipments jumped 14.18% to 156.6 million metric tons in July, with Australia and Brazil accounting for much of the increase. Brazil is also entering its peak export season this quarter, while Australian shipments are expected to gradually rebound after a relatively weak start to the new fiscal year. Meanwhile, China imported 108.086 million tons of iron ore and concentrates in July, down 4.09% from June but 3.5% higher than a year earlier. Data released over the weekend also showed consumer and producer inflation in top consumer China slowed in July, pointing to persistently weak domestic demand. Elsewhere, traders monitored an expanding strike at BHP’s Port Hedland export operations in Western Australia, raising concerns over potential supply disruptions.

【上海期貨交易所：對2人暫停開倉交易12個月】8月10日，上海期貨交易所釋出違規處理決定公告：2026年1月8日至1月23日，王先躍、謝遠超分別使用王先躍賬戶與他人賬戶，在陰極銅期權合約等合約上相互交易，轉移資金、擾亂市場秩序。上述行為已構成《上海期貨交易所違規處理辦法》第三十二條第一款第三項的違規行為，依據該辦法第三十二條之規定，交易所決定：1. 給予王先躍、謝遠超通報批評處分；2. 責令改正，給予王先躍、謝遠超自收到違規處理決定書次日起暫停開倉交易12個月的處分。
葉門政府媒體報道稱，葉門軍方轟炸了馬裡卜省胡塞武裝的軍事據點和導彈發射架。
【馬雲現身西北，探訪沙漠農業和水資源利用】近日，接連有網友稱在甘肅、新疆偶遇阿里巴巴創始人馬雲。照片顯示，馬雲一身休閒穿搭，戴著草帽和墨鏡，曬得挺黑，看起和周圍人也聊得很熱烈。據瞭解，馬雲這次途經甘肅、新疆，主要是探訪西北沙漠農業發展與水資源利用。（新浪科技）
Al Jazeera, citing Yemeni government media, reported Yemen's military struck Houthi military positions and missile launchers in Marib province.

【Dealers confirm Chevrolet has suspended new-car sales in China】Several authorized Chevrolet dealers confirmed the brand has suspended new-car sales in China; timelines varied, with some saying the halt began around the end of last year and others saying the pause has lasted more than a year. GM China said Cadillac and Buick retain competitive advantages in their segments and can support sustainable growth, that Chevrolet’s product line is best suited to export demand, and that Chevrolet models will continue to be manufactured in China as the company explores overseas markets outside the US; GM China also said it will continue to provide after-sales support to existing Chinese Chevrolet owners.
【鵬鷂環保：現階段暫無沼氣提純、發電成套裝備相關研發及產業化拓展計劃】鵬鷂環保(300664)8月10日在互動平臺表示，公司現階段暫無沼氣提純、發電成套裝備相關研發及產業化拓展計劃。
【華瓷股份：奈米氧化鋯、氧化鋯研磨珠產品已在新能源等領域批次供貨】華瓷股份(001216)8月10日在互動平臺回覆稱，目前公司奈米氧化鋯、氧化鋯研磨珠產品已在新能源、電子元器件、醫用齒科領域實現規模化批次供貨。

【經銷商人士證實：雪佛蘭已暫停在華新車銷售】近日，雪佛蘭退出中國市場話題在業內引發熱議。通用中國今日回應稱，在中國，凱迪拉克與別克在各自的細分市場中具備良好的競爭優勢，能夠支援業務的可持續增長；而合資企業旗下的雪佛蘭產品線則最契合出口市場需求。通用中國方面強調，雪佛蘭產品將繼續在中國生產，並積極探索在美國以外的海外市場機遇。對於現有的中國雪佛蘭車主，公司將提供完善的售後服務保障。多位雪佛蘭授權經銷商內部人士證實，雪佛蘭已經暫停在華新車銷售，但各方提及的停售時點存在差異：有經銷商稱，停售大致從去年年底啟動，也有經銷商表示，銷售停滯已持續一年有餘。（第一財經）
【百花獎首次設立AIGC單元】第38屆大眾電影百花獎AIGC推優單元榮譽盛典日前在北京舉辦。這是百花獎創辦64年來首次為AIGC影像開設專門徵集通道。活動在一個多月內收到2038件投稿，最終30部作品進入終審，24部獲入圍榮譽，6部獲推優榮譽。終審評委俞白眉把AI比作“牛奶倒進了水”，是分子結合而非簡單替代，“目前所有創意靈感都來自於人類，方向盤還在人的手裡”。
據上海航運交易所資料，截至2026年8月10日，上海出口集裝箱結算運價指數（歐洲航線）報3383.88點，與上期相比跌3.9%。
和碩：7月銷售額860.2億元新臺幣，同比增長11.6%。

【Drone strike on Nizhnekamsk petrochemical hub kills 12】Nizhnekamsk mayor Radmir Belyaev said Ukrainian drones struck industrial and civilian targets in the Tatarstan city on Aug. 10; RIA reported 12 dead and 39 injured. Multiple Russian outlets said one of the region’s most technologically advanced refineries was damaged; Nizhnekamsk, on the Kama River, is a major Russian petrochemical and refining centre.

【俄石化重鎮遭烏無人機襲擊已致12人死】俄羅斯韃靼斯坦共和國下卡姆斯克市市長拉德米爾·別利亞耶夫今天（8月10日）在社交媒體平臺發宣告稱，烏克蘭無人機對該市的工業和民用目標實施了襲擊。據俄新社報道，襲擊已造成當地12人死亡、39人受傷。據多家俄羅斯媒體報道，該地區技術最為先進的煉油廠之一在此次襲擊中受損。 下卡姆斯克是俄羅斯韃靼斯坦共和國的一座工業城市，位於卡馬河沿岸，是該地區重要的石油化工中心，擁有大型煉油廠。 （CCTV國際時訊）
【2026年服貿會進入倒計時一個月180餘項創新成果將集中釋出】今天（10日），距離2026年中國國際服務貿易交易會（以下簡稱“服貿會”）開幕還有一個月。在服貿會永久會址首鋼園區，一系列組展辦會和服務保障細節正式釋出。本屆服貿會上，80餘家企業和機構計劃釋出180餘項創新成果，並首次設定“出海服務企業展區”，展會國際化、專業化、市場化水平進一步提升。（央視新聞）
【豪能股份等在瀘州成立新材料科技公司 註冊資本200萬歐元】天眼查App顯示，近日，豪能梯愛司新材料科技（瀘州）有限公司成立，法定代表人為楊貴根，註冊資本200萬歐元，經營範圍包括新材料技術研發、金屬表面處理及熱處理加工、真空鍍膜加工、新型膜材料製造等，由成都豪能科技股份有限公司等共同持股。
【東鵬飲料在鄭州成立維他命飲料公司】企查查APP顯示，近日，鄭州東鵬維他命飲料有限公司成立，法定代表人為徐仕兵，註冊資本為1億元，經營範圍包含飲料生產；食品生產；食品用塑膠包裝容器工具製品生產；食品網際網路銷售（僅銷售預包裝食品）等。企查查股權穿透顯示，該公司由東鵬飲料全資持股。

【A-shares close: Shanghai Composite up 0.67%; specialty metals, livestock lead gains】A-shares ended mixed after intraday swings. Shanghai Composite rose 0.67%, Shenzhen Composite up 0.04% and the ChiNext Index down 0.73%. Turnover on the two exchanges exceeded 2.5 trillion yuan and more than 3,800 stocks advanced. Markets weakened in the morning and sold off after lunch—ChiNext fell over 2.5% at one point—before a broad late recovery that left Shenzhen marginally positive. Sector action: livestock and defense led gains, specialty metals active, cinema chains rallied in the afternoon, innovative pharmaceuticals pulled back after earlier strength; CPO and advanced packaging remained under pressure all day, and components were weak.
義大利Technoprobe股價上漲2%，米蘭上市意法半導體（STM）股價早盤上漲1.8%。
【ETF兩市成交額報4879.61億元，較上一交易日此時縮量511.13億元】截至目前，ETF兩市成交額報4879.61億元，較上一交易日此時縮量511.13億元，分型別來看，股票型ETF成交額1643.38億元，債券型ETF成交額2044.9億元，貨幣型ETF成交額314.52億元，商品型ETF成交額111.98億元，QDII型ETF成交額764.82億元。

UK Natural Gas Prices Advance — UK natural gas prices rose above 140 pence per therm on Monday, recovering part of the losses from the previous week amid uncertainty over the normalization of shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. Iran and Oman remained short of a final agreement over the weekend after Tehran renewed a lengthy list of demands for Washington as conditions for a full reopening of the strategic waterway, indicating any immediate relief for gas supplies could remain limited. Although Iran indicated that a deal was close, it cautioned that this did not mean the strait would reopen imminently, while again ruling out any direct negotiations with the US. With a deal still elusive, disruptions to LNG shipments through the key waterway are likely to persist, delaying cargoes from major exporters such as Qatar. The ongoing delays have kept global supply balances tight, intensifying competition with Asian buyers for available cargoes and hampering Europe's winter stockpiling efforts.

Offshore Yuan Retreats After Inflation Data — The offshore yuan weakened to around 6.74 per dollar on Monday, retreating from a more than three-year high reached in the previous session, as softer inflation data underscored persistent weakness in domestic demand. Annual consumer inflation eased to a six-month low of 0.5% in July, reflecting declines in food prices and slower growth in non-food costs. Producer price inflation also moderated to 3.5% from 4.1%, marking its first slowdown since returning to positive territory in March amid an oil-price surge triggered by Middle East tensions. Meanwhile, the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee recently pledged more proactive and effective macroeconomic policies, including the faster deployment of fiscal funds and bond proceeds, while continuing to support large-scale equipment upgrades and consumer goods trade-in programs. It also emphasized the need to boost domestic demand as consumer spending remains subdued despite solid exports and industrial output.

TAIEX Ends 1.6% Higher, Near 4-Week High — The TAIEX, Taiwan’s benchmark stock index, gained 703 points, or 1.6%, to close at 44,929 on Monday, halting losses from the previous two sessions and tracking a rally on Wall Street on Friday after weaker-than-expected jobs data eased concerns over Fed rate hikes at the upcoming meeting. The broader index hit its highest level since July 16 after consolidating in the previous session amid concerns over massive spending on AI. The increase was mainly driven by health technology and electronic technology stocks, which climbed 2.1%. TSMC, the world's largest contract chipmaker, which accounts for more than 40% of the market's total value, rose 0.4%, while MediaTek advanced 1.5% and Delta Electronics jumped 10.0%. However, rising oil prices limited the gains, as concerns over inflation raised expectations of interest rate hikes. Traders also anticipated the release of US inflation data due this week for clues about the Fed's monetary policy decision at its upcoming meeting.

Sweden Posts Strongest Order Growth Since 2022 — Total orders received by Sweden jumped 29.9% year-on-year in June 2026, marking the sharpest rise since December 2022 and accelerating from an upwardly revised 1.6% increase in the previous month. Orders from customers abroad surged by 57.6% (vs. 3.3% in May), which more than offset a 7.4% decline in domestic demand (vs. -0.9%). Among industrial groupings, orders for capital goods (50.7% vs -3.6%) and intermediate goods (30.6% vs -3.1%) recorded the strongest growth. Meanwhile, orders for non-durable consumer goods increased at a slower pace (1.0% vs 12.6%), while durable consumer goods fell 4.3% (vs -4.0%). Energy-related goods excluding durable goods also remained in contraction (-3.5% vs -7.9%). On a monthly basis, total orders surged by 32.3%, rebounding sharply from a 3.2% fall in May. For the January–June period, total orders were 4% higher than the corresponding period a year ago, as domestic demand was unchanged while the export market has increased.

Westpac Slide Pulls ASX 200 Down 0.3% at Finish — The ASX 200 slipped 31 points, or 0.3%, to close at 9,233 on Monday, marking a second consecutive decline as declines in financials, consumer durables, and industrial services weighed. Sentiment stayed cautious ahead of the Reserve Bank of Australia's monetary policy decision. While markets expect cash rates to remain at 4.35% after three hikes this year, inflation risks linger amid geopolitical uncertainty. Financials were hit hard by a 5.4% drop in Westpac after the lender flagged halved investor housing credit growth next year and a 20% slide in mortgage applications, alongside softer quarterly cash earnings of AUD 1.8 billion. Peers ANZ, Commonwealth Bank, and NAB also shed about 2%. Still, miners provided some offset, supported by firm metal prices, with BHP up 1.2% and Rio Tinto adding 0.6%. Treasury Wine Estates surged 4.8% after announcing plans to shrink its U.S. North Coast vintages from 2026 and write down bulk wine inventory.

【美國前空軍部長被指洩露“空軍一號”機密】美國民主黨籍前總統拜登執政時的空軍部長弗蘭克·肯德爾近日被指向媒體洩露有關總統專機“空軍一號”的機密資訊，其安全許可被政府撤銷。據《華盛頓郵報》上週末報道，肯德爾近期接受《紐約時報》和《華爾街日報》採訪時，談及卡達贈送給現任共和黨籍總統特朗普的波音747型“空軍一號”存在安全缺陷。肯德爾稱，對這架專機用於美國本土以外地區感到“意外”。他認為專機改裝速度過快，質疑是否已“最大化”安防特性。五角大樓發言人肖恩·帕內爾經由社交媒體證實，肯德爾“未經授權披露有關‘空軍一號’效能的機密資訊 ”，因而被撤銷參閱機密資訊的許可權，不得出任任何敏感職位。（新華社）

Saudi Arabia Industrial Output Falls at Softer Pace — Industrial production in Saudi Arabia fell 16.3% year-on-year in June 2026, easing from an 18.7% slump in the previous month. Output in the oil sector fell at a softer pace (-23.2% vs -26.3% in May), largely reflecting a softer decline in crude petroleum and natural gas extraction (-27.0% vs -28.6%) and coke and refined petroleum products output (-6.0% vs -16.7%). Moreover, growth in other economic activities edged up to 3.4% from 3.3%, supported by a rebound in electricity, gas, steam, and air-conditioning supply (2.8% vs -1.4%) and faster expansion in water supply, sewerage, waste management, and remediation activities (6.0% vs 5.7%). However, non-oil activity growth eased slightly to 0.1% from 0.5%, despite a softer decline in manufacturing output (-0.5% vs -0.6%). On a monthly basis, industrial production increased 4.6%, accelerating from a 3.2% rise in May.

Romania Trade Gap Widens in June — Romania’s trade deficit widened to EUR 2.961 billion in June 2026 from EUR 2.397 billion in the corresponding month a year earlier. Exports increased 5.9% year-on-year to EUR 8.702 billion, supported by higher shipments to both EU (4.8%) and non-EU countries (8.8%). Meanwhile, imports rose 9.9% to EUR 11.663 billion, mainly due to higher purchases from both EU (10.9%) and non-EU markets (7.2%). During the January-June period, exports increased by 3.0% to EUR 49.038 billion, driven by higher sales of food and live animals (7.8%), manufactured goods classified by raw materials (7.0%), and machinery and transport equipment (1.7%). Meanwhile, imports rose 1.7% to EUR 65.498 billion, with arrivals increasing for machinery and transport equipment (2.0%), manufactured goods classified by raw materials (0.4%), and chemical and related products (2.9%). The country’s trade gap was EUR 16.460 billion, lower by EUR 0.3 billion, or 2.0%, compared to the same period last year.

【摩根士丹利威爾遜：市場行情擴散，看好優質股】每股收益增長面擴大、上調盈利預期增多，促使摩根士丹利策略師同時看好優質股票與人工智慧應用企業。由邁克爾・威爾遜牽頭的研究團隊表示：“市場正越來越青睞高質量盈利、強勁自由現金流以及由人工智慧帶來經營效率提升的標的。”策略師指出，羅素 3000 成分股的中位數每股收益增速達 15%，為 2021 年以來最高；營收增速 8%，是 2023 年以來的最好水平。該團隊看好優質風格因子及人工智慧應用企業；維持高配大型金融服務板塊，相較於晶片股更偏好超大規模科技雲廠商。

Denmark Trade Surplus Widens in June — Denmark’s seasonally adjusted trade surplus widened to DKK 28.7 billion in June 2026, from a downwardly revised DKK 25.8 billion in the previous month, highest in three months. Exports increased 0.9% month-over-month to DKK 193.5 billion, driven by a 1.7% rise in services exports to DKK 81.0 billion and a 0.4% increase in goods exports to DKK 112.5 billion. Meanwhile, imports fell 0.7% to DKK 164.8 billion, as a 0.5% decline in goods imports and a 0.8%. In the second quarter, total exports increased by 5.7%, while imports increased by 6.9%. In the first half of 2026, Denmark recorded a trade surplus of DKK 163.2 billion, rising from DKK 154.4 billion in the same period of 2025.

Lithuania Inflation Rate at Almost 3-Year High — Lithuania’s annual inflation rate rose to 5.9% in July 2026 from 5.7% in the previous month, marking the highest level since August 2023. Prices increased at a faster pace for housing and utilities (15.1% vs 12.0% in June), furnishings, household equipment and routine household maintenance (2.4% vs 1.2%), health (4.9% vs 3.8%), education (5.3% vs 5.0%), and clothing and footwear (1.8% vs 1.7%). Meanwhile, inflation eased in transport (12.5% vs 13.4%), alcoholic beverages and tobacco (7.6% vs 7.8%), information and communication (1.6% vs 3.1%), recreation, sport and culture (5.2% vs 5.8%), restaurants and accommodation (5.5% vs 6.1%), insurance and financial services (5.3% vs 5.6%), and miscellaneous goods and services (5.7% vs 5.8%). Additionally, food and non-alcoholic beverage prices declined (-0.3% vs 0.1%). On a monthly basis, consumer prices increased 0.2% in July, easing from 0.5% in the previous month.

Norway Inflation Rate Rises to 3% — Norway’s annual inflation rate rose to 3% in July 2026 from 2.7% in the previous month. Price growth mainly accelerated for housing, water, electricity, gas and other fuels (4.6% vs. 3.4% in June) and transport (2.6% vs. 1.7%), amid elevated global energy prices. Inflation also increased for health (4.4% vs. 3.8%), recreation, sport and culture (4.3% vs. 3.2%), and clothing and footwear (2.9% vs. 2.6%). By contrast, price growth slowed for food and non-alcoholic beverages (1.1% vs. 2.3%), furnishings and household equipment (0.5% vs. 2.3%), alcoholic beverages, tobacco and narcotics (2.6% vs. 2.8%), restaurants and accommodation services (5.7% vs. 6.0%), and insurance and financial services (7.9% vs. 8.9%). On a monthly basis, consumer prices jumped 1%, the most since February 2025, following a 0.2% decline in June. Meanwhile, the CPI-ATE, which excludes energy prices and tax changes, rose 2.7% year-on-year, unchanged from June, while increasing 0.8% month-on-month.

Sweden Industrial Output Falls for 1st Time in 15 Months — Industrial production in Sweden fell by 1.5% year-on-year in June 2026, slipping from an upwardly revised and eight-month high of a 7.6% growth in the previous month. The latest figure marked the first contraction since March 2025, largely driven by a sharp decline in mining production, down 13.8% after an 8.5% rise in May. Activity also decreased in the manufacturing sector (-1% vs 7.6%), reflecting weaker output for coke and refined petroleum products (-3.6% vs -5.7%), rubber and plastic products (-4.4% vs 3.6%), and basic metals (-3.8% vs -3.2%), which more than offset increases for textiles, clothing, and leather (3.5% vs 6.3%) and other non-metallic mineral products (7.3% vs 11.1%). On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, industrial output fell by 0.4%, following an upwardly revised 0.6% gain in the preceding period.

【光大期貨：非農創年內新低，黃金底部區間更穩固】下半年以來黃金價格走勢與美伊地緣存在脫敏跡象，市場博弈點主要放在美聯儲是否“敢於”加息上。此前美國經濟資料表現韌性，但通脹資料略顯頑固，加息預期一度佔據主導，特別是美聯儲9月議息會議加息機率不斷走高；但隨著美股高位表現偏弱，以及就業資料表現出來的不穩定性，市場對美聯儲特別是沃什“鷹派”作風表現質疑，而非農就業資料的意外走弱直接擊穿了此前市場對9月加息的定價，美債收益率和美元同步走弱，也強化了美國在高債務與頑固通脹間舉步維艱的觀點。另外，此前黃金ETF再次流出給予市場一定打擊，但世界黃金協會資料顯示，央行二季度淨買入289噸黃金創歷史紀錄，特別是中國央行連續5個月加大購金量再次提振市場信心。因此總體來看，當前位置為黃金底部區間的觀點或更加穩固，宜逢低配置，階段性關注黃金在連續衝高後是否存在短線情緒亢奮獲利了結的風險。（光大期貨）

Denmark Inflation Eases to 1.7% in July — The annual inflation rate in Denmark eased to 1.7% in July 2026 from 1.9% in each of the previous two months. The main downward pressures came from housing and utilities, where prices were unchanged (0% vs 0.5% in June), and a sharper decline in food prices (-1.6% vs -0.9%). Price growth also softened for personal care and miscellaneous goods and services (1.5% vs 1.8%), leisure, sports and culture (0.8% vs 2.8%), and clothing and footwear (0.9% vs 2.3%). On a monthly basis, consumer prices increased by 1.3%, following a 0.2% rise in the previous month.

Norway Producer Inflation Picks Up in July — Producer prices in Norway surged 23.4% year-on-year in July 2026, picking up from a four-month low of 14.9% in the previous month. The increase was driven mainly by a sharp acceleration in energy-related prices, with costs for the extraction of oil and natural gas jumping to 38.2% from 15.2% in June, while energy goods inflation climbed to 39.8% from 23.9%. In contrast, price growth eased in manufacturing (6.4% vs 8.6%) and in electricity, gas, and steam (41.0% vs 68.8%). Excluding energy goods, producer price inflation was unchanged at 5.3%, indicating more moderate underlying price pressures. On a monthly basis, producer prices rose 8.9%, rebounding strongly from a 7.1% decline in June.

Denmark Current Account Surplus Hits 3-Month High — Denmark’s seasonally adjusted current account surplus rose to DKK 32.5 billion in June 2026 from a downwardly revised DKK 25.7 billion in the previous month, marking the largest increase in three months. The goods account surplus widened to DKK 23.5 billion from DKK 22.5 billion, lifted by a 0.4% rise in exports while imports fell by 0.5%. Additionally, the services account surplus increased to DKK 5.3 billion from DKK 3.3 billion, while the primary income surplus also grew to DKK 7.3 billion from DKK 3.1 billion a month earlier. In contrast, the secondary income deficit increased to DKK 3.6 billion from DKK 3.3 billion.

【民調：李在明施政好評率降至43.3%創任內新低】韓國民調機構Realmeter10日釋出的民調結果顯示，總統李在明的施政好評率降至43.3%，連續第四周下降，創下其任內新低。Realmeter受日刊《能源經濟新聞》委託，本月3日至7日對全國18歲以上2514人進行調查。結果顯示，李在明施政好評率較前一週下降2.6個百分點，為43.3%。差評率上升2.5個百分點，為53%。Realmeter分析認為，政府出臺房地產稅新規，旨在廢除檢方偵查權的新版《刑訴法》在執政黨主導下獲得國會透過，李在明提及軍事政變風險並要求加快推進陸海空三軍軍校整合，這些因素引發輿論爭議，加上高溫天氣持續、經濟不確定性加劇，導致支援率連續四周呈現下降趨勢。
【華能瀾滄江（施甸）新能源有限公司成立，註冊資本2.4億】天眼查App顯示，近日，華能瀾滄江（施甸）新能源有限公司成立，法定代表人為何偉，註冊資本2.4億人民幣，經營範圍包括髮電業務、輸電業務、供（配）電業務，新興能源技術研發，風力發電技術服務，太陽能發電技術服務等，由華能瀾滄江新能源有限公司、通威智慧能源（四川）有限公司共同持股。

【拼多多上線“最快明天達”核心入口：加碼時效履約，插入京東、美團腹地】新浪科技獨家獲悉，近日，拼多多正式上線“最快明天達”核心入口，品類覆蓋水果生鮮、日用百貨等，進一步向由美團、京東主導的即時零售核心腹地滲透。 在此之前，拼多多並未設定相關的一級入口，僅透過演算法在商品頁或搜尋結果頁動態展示“明天達”標識。此次將“明天達”提升至首頁核心導航位，被業內視為拼多多在時效履約能力上的一次重要升級，也是其向“次日達”乃至更短時效配送體系邁出的關鍵一步。 對此，拼多多客服承認“最快明天達”入口為近期最新上線。至於上線原因，客服回應稱：“是為了最佳化消費體驗，給消費者提供保障服務。”當被問及未來是否會上線外賣業務時，對方表示“暫時沒有收到通知”。（新浪科技）

【今日起豆包渠道的酒店訂單開始執行獨立費率，綜合扣費12%】有訊息稱，從今日起，透過豆包入口跳轉抖音來客成交的酒店訂單，將執行獨立費率：11.4%的軟體服務費加0.6%的支付手續費，綜合費率約12%。對此，有酒店行業人士表示，此訊息屬實，網傳照片為抖音來客後臺的通知，“現在豆包推薦酒店已經要收佣金了。”目前，位元組跳動方面暫無回應。（新浪科技）

【駕校抱團漲價、協會牽頭串謀……全國市場監管部門整治駕培壟斷】市場監管總局訊息，近年來，全國機動車保有量持續增長，下沉市場出行需求旺盛，但部分縣域及三、四線城市駕培行業滋生抱團漲價、協會串謀、收費失規、培訓縮水等亂象，成為群眾反映強烈的民生痛點。2022年至今，全國市場監管部門累計辦結、在辦駕培壟斷案件12件，覆蓋10餘個省份，西南、西北地區縣域為高發區域；案件共涉及百餘家本地駕校，單案涉案主體4家至17家不等，駕培企業“抱團漲價”問題突出。下一步，市場監管部門將持續保持反壟斷高壓態勢，常態化整治駕培領域壟斷與各類違規行為。

【China deputy foreign minister Miao Deyu meets South African deputy foreign minister Molaka】Aug 4, 2026 — China's Deputy Foreign Minister Miao Deyu met South African Deputy Foreign Minister Molaka in China. Miao cited the 2024 FOCAC Beijing summit decision by President Xi and President Ramaphosa to elevate China–South Africa ties to a new-era, all-round strategic cooperative partnership, and reiterated Beijing's announced zero-tariff measures for all African diplomatic partners. China signalled readiness to expand bilateral cooperation in governance, power and energy, and artificial intelligence, deepen people-to-people exchanges, and coordinate with South Africa within BRICS and other multilateral forums to uphold multilateralism and international fairness.

【外交部副部長苗得雨會見南非副外長莫拉卡】2026年8月4日，外交部副部長苗得雨會見來華參會的南非副外長莫拉卡。苗得雨表示，在2024年中非合作論壇北京峰會期間，習近平主席和拉馬福薩總統共同決定將中南關係提升為新時代全方位戰略合作伙伴關係，為兩國關係作出戰略指引。過去兩年來，兩國高層交往不斷，各領域合作深入推進，為兩國發展注入強勁動力。習近平主席宣佈對所有非洲建交國實施零關稅舉措，有力促進中非經貿合作。中方願同南方在實現現代化程序中堅定相互支援，進一步拓展治國理政、電力能源、人工智慧等合作，深化人文交流，加強在金磚等多邊框架內協作，共同維護多邊主義和國際公平正義。

【萊茵河水位過低或中斷航運 航道“一分為二”】德國聯邦內河航運協會10日說，萊茵河一處關鍵河段本週或將因水位過低中斷貨運，這條重要航道相當於被分割為兩段。該協會主管延斯·施瓦寧告訴《萊茵郵報》，由於降雨不足，作為萊茵河航道關鍵卡口的考布水文站水位預計將首次降至個位數。考布水文站位於科布倫茨市以南，地處萊茵河中段水位最淺的河段之一。該河段水位曾在2018年10月低至25釐米，當時許多大型船隻難以安全透過。施瓦寧表示，如果這一河段的水位降至個位數，“將無法開展商業貨運，同時也會影響短途觀光遊船與郵輪航運”。這實際上相當於，“萊茵河不再全線貫通，航道分割為兩段”。（新華社）

【Shooting at Nonthaburi Provincial Administrative Organization office; chairman critically injured】Thai media reported on the 10th that a shooting occurred inside the Nonthaburi Provincial Administrative Organization office at about 11:00 local time. The organization's chairman, Thongchai, was shot in the head and is in serious condition; his private driver was also injured. Both were taken to hospital. The suspect surrendered to police and authorities are investigating.

【香港金管局與迪拜金管局合辦第三屆氣候金融會議 在變局中推動轉型】香港金融管理局與迪拜金融服務管理局今日（8月10日）宣佈將於9月10日在香港合辦第三屆聯合氣候金融會議（會議）。香港金管局總裁餘偉文表示：“面對全球不確定性為綠色轉型帶來的挑戰，香港與迪拜等主要可持續金融樞紐應攜手合作，將資本引導至切實可行的方案。我們很高興能夠促成跨地區對話，並期待能將討論轉化為實際的業務和投資機遇。”迪拜金管局總裁施衛民表示：“是次會議充分體現了迪拜金管局與香港金管局之間的緊密合作伙伴關係，並提供了一個寶貴平臺，供各方交流前瞻見解、加強跨地域合作，共同推動兩地可持續金融的持續發展。”

【HKMA, DFSA to co-host 3rd Joint Climate Finance Conference in Hong Kong on Sept 10】The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) and the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA) said they will co-host the third Joint Climate Finance Conference in Hong Kong on Sept 10 to deepen cross-border sustainable finance cooperation, steer capital toward investable green projects, and convert dialogue into business and investment opportunities across the two hubs.

【北京房產新政第一批受益者正在出現】“一天帶了20組，比上個月週末兩天加起來都多”“週末售樓處到訪量明顯上來了”……北京房地產政策進一步最佳化後的首個週末，記者走訪多家二手房中介門店和新房售樓處發現，二手房帶看量、客戶見面約談量明顯上升，新房到訪量也有所增加，購房者入市意願增強，市場信心得到提振。8月9日下午，記者走進朝陽區華威北里一家中介門店。這一帶是北京樓市的典型剛需板塊。下午3點，店裡的工位空了大半。“12個買賣經紀人，今天全出去帶看了，這會兒還有兩個單子在談。”門店經理陳德強翻了翻記錄，8月8日門店總共帶看了18組客戶，“以往週末一天也就帶看12組左右。線上諮詢的也多了。”（北京晚報）
【百度搭子連續推出生產力套件，加碼AI辦公】記者8月10日獲悉，百度搭子先後上線設計套件和金融套件，進一步擴充套件AI辦公場景。繼7月10日上線自媒體套件後，百度搭子已連續推出三類生產力套件，覆蓋內容生產、頁面製作和金融分析等任務。

【基金公司因產品風格漂移、無資質大V帶貨被追責】監管層近日向各家機構下發最新一期的《機構監管情況通報》，近日，C基金公司管理的部分基金產品出現“風格漂移”“大V帶貨”等問題，引發關注。監管機構第一時間組織開展現場核查，對相關機構和個人依法從嚴採取監管措施。經查，C基金公司存在投資運作不規範、宣傳推介不合規等兩方面違規問題。監管機構決定對該公司採取責令改正並暫停受理公募基金產品註冊3個月的監管措施，同步追究公司總經理、分管網路營銷副總、網路金融部負責人、基金經理等責任人員責任。《通報》也再次強調相關監管要求，包括投前審慎界定投資方向、投中加強投資風格管理、不得與無資質“大V”合作、加強從業人員管理等。
【數字政通等在河北成立智慧算力公司 含AI相關業務】企查查APP顯示，近日，中數政通（河北）智慧算力有限公司成立，經營範圍包含人工智慧公共資料平臺；人工智慧應用軟體開發；人工智慧基礎軟體開發；人工智慧行業應用系統整合服務等。企查查股權穿透顯示，該公司由數字政通全資子公司北京政通智算科技有限公司等共同持股。

【TrendForce: iPhone 18 256GB BOM up ~38% YoY; Apple may trim gross margin to limit price hikes】TrendForce estimates the iPhone 18 series BOM for the 256GB model will rise about 38% YoY, driven primarily by higher component costs led by memory. That cost pressure would push retail prices higher; TrendForce says Apple may accept lower gross margins to curb price increases and preserve shipments and market share.

Egypt Inflation Rate at 3-Month High of 14.9% — Egypt's annual urban inflation accelerated for the first time in four months to 14.9% in July 2026 from 14.3% in June, but remained below market expectations of 15.1%. It was the highest inflation rate since April. On a monthly basis, the CPI was unchanged after falling 0.4% in the previous month, which marked the first monthly decline since July 2025.

【公募REITs二級市場延續調整走勢，上海釋出工商業專案土地使用權續期新政】上週公募REITs二級市場延續了調整走勢。截至上週五（8月7日），中證REITs（收盤）指數週內下跌1.69%，收於701.5點；中證REITs全收益指數環比下跌1.64%，收於938.1點。除生態環保、市政、水利REITs收漲外，其他型別REITs均收跌。資料顯示，已上市的88只公募REITs產品中，環比上漲的減少至13只。漲幅最大的三隻產品分別為中金中國綠髮消費REIT、中航首鋼綠能REIT和中信建投明陽智慧新能源REIT，周內漲幅分別為3.04%、1.86%和1.55%。環比下跌的增加至73只，還有2只表現持平。跌幅最大的三隻產品為中信建投瀋陽國際軟體園REIT、中航易商倉儲物流REIT和博時蛇口產園REIT，其中中信建投瀋陽國際軟體園REIT周內跌幅超過10%。政策與行業方面，上海釋出工商業專案土地使用權續期新政，專門明確“擬發行REITs等特殊情形，申請年限可根據專案實際情況確定”。東北首單能源公募REITs——華泰三峽新能源REIT成功上市，華泰紫金金鷹商業不動產REIT正式申報。（每日經濟新聞）

【機構：預估iPhone 18 Pro成本大增近40%，蘋果或調整毛利策略以穩健出貨】根據TrendForce集邦諮詢最新手機產業研究，由於以儲存器為首的零部件價格上漲，推升Apple（蘋果）將釋出的iPhone 18系列整機成本。以該系列的256GB版本BOM（物料清單）成本為例，預估年增幅度達38%左右，整機售價勢必提高。為避免影響消費者購買意願，Apple可能借由降低毛利的方式控制售價漲幅，以換取市佔擴張。

【江西省生物多樣性金融貸款餘額突破3000億元】記者從人民銀行江西省分行獲悉，我省在推進綠色金融改革中，持續深耕生物多樣性金融創新實踐，不斷完善適配本地生態稟賦的金融支援體系。截至今年7月底，全省生物多樣性金融貸款餘額達3181.36億元。 從重點投向領域看，全省生物多樣性貸款主要投向生物多樣性管理和服務、可持續林業、可持續農牧業、生態修復、資源迴圈利用、汙染治理等領域。其中，生物多樣性管理和服務領域佔比最高，達26%；可持續林業領域佔22%；可持續農牧業領域和生態修復領域分別佔18%和17%；資源迴圈利用和汙染治理領域分別佔9%和6%。（江西日報）

【臺積電7月營業額同比躍增45% 顯示AI硬體需求不墜】臺積電公佈7月份營業額同比增長45%，顯示儘管市場波動，但對AI硬體的需求仍然強勁。這家英偉達和蘋果公司首選的晶片製造商7月營收達4,675.8億元臺幣(145億美元)。上個月，臺積電上調年度支出和營收預測，反映出其對AI晶片強勁增長動能將持續到2027年及之後的信心。臺積電目前預計，2026年資本支出將達到創紀錄的600億-640億美元，並預測以美元計的全年營收增幅將略高於40%。科技股估值在7月陷入停滯，外界持續擔心資料中心產能過剩，並質疑數以萬億美元計的AI相關支出能否帶來實質回報。臺積電股價較6月末的高點下跌約5%，但今年以來累計上漲超過50%。

NZX 50 Snaps 2-Session Losing Streak, Ends 0.5% Higher — New Zealand's stocks rose 64 points, or 0.5%, to close at 13,888 on Monday, halting losses in the previous two sessions, tracking a rise on Wall Street on Friday after softer-than-expected labor data dampened expectations of a Fed rate hike at the September meeting. The broader index was mainly supported by gains in healthcare, financials, and industrials. Positive trade data from China, New Zealand's top trading partner, with export growth remaining robust, continued to help cap the losses, while inflation eased to a six-month low. However, traders anticipated the release of US inflation data this week for clues about the Fed's monetary policy at the upcoming meeting, while rising oil prices capped the gains amid uncertainty over whether to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Among the top performers were Ryman Healthcare (2.4%), Infratil (2.2%), Ebos Group (1.8%), Fisher & Paykel (1.2%), F&C Investment (0.9%), Hallenstein Glasson (0.8%), and Mainfreight (0.7%).

【中證協啟動專業人員水平測試全行業調研 測試體系迎最佳化視窗】從業內悉，中國證券業協會近日在行業內釋出通知，就證券行業專業人員水平評價測試開展全行業問卷調研。據悉，中證協此次同步面向證券公司與2026年以來參加過證券行業水平測試的從業人員發放雙向問卷，圍繞測試內容合理性與認可度、測試內容與監管導向及行業發展的適配度、測試組織執行效率、對專項測試的最佳化建議等核心維度徵集意見。本次調研截止時間為8月28日，相關反饋將作為後續測試大綱、教材、命題及組織模式調整的核心依據，標誌著證券業水平測試體系正迎來新一輪系統性評估與最佳化視窗期。從公司版調研問卷來看，調研直指行業人才需求轉型與測試定位的適配問題。 (中證金牛座)

【水利部：黃河、太湖、滁河等河流可能發生編號洪水】今天（8月10日）上午，水利部舉行會商，分析研判全國的防汛形勢，未來兩天，黃河、太湖、滁河等主要河流可能發生編號洪水，安徽西南部局地需防範山洪災害。截至今天9時，浙江、上海、江蘇、黑龍江、內蒙古、雲南等地65條河流仍維持超警。8月10日至12日，受降雨影響，黃河、太湖、滁河、淠河、沙潁河、伊洛河、衛河等主要河流可能發生編號洪水，暴雨區內部分中小河流可能發生較大洪水；受上游來水影響，松花江幹流及支流呼蘭河、黑龍江干流同江以下江段將維持超警。8月10日8時至8月11日8時，河南東南部、安徽西南部、浙江北部發生山洪災害的可能性大（橙色預警）；其中，安徽西南部局地發生山洪災害的可能性很大（紅色預警）。水利部今天8時釋出紅色山洪災害氣象預警，維持洪水藍色預警。

【平安證券：首予國力電子“推薦”評級，認為公司具備較好的成長潛力】平安證券研報指出，半導體零部件及金剛石助力，電子真空器件可期。國力電子為國內稀缺的綜合性電子真空器件平臺型企業，核心技術覆蓋真空器件全製造環節，下游橫跨半導體裝置、新能源、航天航空及軍工、大科學等領域。半導體裝置端，受益全球晶圓資本開支擴張與國內零部件自主替代浪潮，真空電容器對標海外龍頭，已批次供貨北方華創、中微公司等頭部裝置商與射頻電源企業，依託本土化服務與成本優勢持續提升滲透率，半導體業務佔比有望持續上行。同時，AI驅動金剛石散熱需求爆發，大功率磁控管作為MPCVD裝置核心部件，公司是國內少數具備穩定量產能力廠商，已實現小規模供貨，有望為公司營收開啟新的成長空間，塑造第二增長曲線。預計2026-2028年公司EPS分別為為1.59元、3.03元和5.08元，對應8月6日收盤價的PE分別為46.9X、24.6X和14.7X。認為公司具備較好的成長潛力，首次覆蓋，給予“推薦”評級。

【東吳證券：維持湯臣倍健“買入”評級，收入延續增長，渠道分化明顯】東吳證券研報指出，湯臣倍健收入延續增長，渠道分化明顯。26H1實現收入/歸母淨利潤/扣非歸母淨利潤36.71/6.03/5.57億元，同比+4%/-18%/-20%；Q2實現收入/歸母淨利潤/扣非歸母淨利潤18.03/2.01/1.81億元，同比+4%/-29%/-36%。26Q2主品牌和健力多仍受藥店客流下降影響，2026Q1-Q2Life-Space收入同比增速提升一是2026H1益生菌品類電商GMV同比增速高於行業大盤；二是公司持續推進“超益計劃”，積極拓展麥角硫因等新品類；三是跨境渠道貢獻增量。2026H1商超渠道收入同比增速較高，山姆（代表產品包括Yep鐵飲系列）、屈臣氏、大潤發等高勢能渠道表現較好，認為系行業新環境下渠道流量重塑。公司年初目標為收入同比雙位數增長，據此推算2026H2收入同比或進一步提速，我們預計其增量或可來自：抖音、跨境電商延續增長、山姆等高勢能渠道持續放量。公司重視東南亞市場的佈局且實現路徑明晰；降本控費、投放精細，費用使用更科學、謹慎。考慮到公司探索積極、短期成本壓力不改長期增長趨勢，維持“買入”評級。

Finnish Industrial Output Picks Up in June — Industrial production in Finland grew by 4.5% year-on-year in June 2026, accelerating from a 0.5% rise in the previous month. Output growth was strongest in the electricity, gas, heating and air conditioning supply industry, where production increased by 5.4% after falling 0.1% in May, while activity for mining and quarrying recovered sharply, up 4.2% after a 10% drop in the prior month. Manufacturing production (4.4% vs 0.6%) also increased faster, reflecting higher output in the forest industry (8.3% vs 1.9%) and the metal sector (9% vs 2.7%). In contrast, output mainly declined for textile, clothing and leather industry (-7.2% vs 4.4%), printing and reproduction of recorded media (-8.5% vs -10.1%), and furniture (-20.3% vs -8.7%). On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, industrial activity rose by 2.1%, rebounding from a downwardly revised 1.7% decrease in the preceding period.

Estonia Trade Deficit Widens in June — Estonia’s trade deficit widened to EUR 413 million in June 2026 from EUR 361 million in the same month last year. Exports climbed 15% year-on-year to EUR 1,657 million, boosted by higher sales to both EU countries (+19%) and non-EU countries (+5%). Exports rose for mineral products (+62%), raw materials and products of the chemical industry (+25%), base metals and articles of base metals (+25%), machinery and mechanical appliances (+20%), agricultural products and food preparations (+15%), and transport equipment (+14%). Imports also jumped 15% to EUR 2,070 million, driven by higher purchases from both EU (+14%) and non-EU (+18%) countries. Notable increases were seen in mineral products (+86%), electrical equipment (+29%), wood and articles of wood (+19%), and machinery and mechanical appliances (+19%). In the first half of the year, the country recorded a trade shortfall of EUR 1,920 million, up from EUR 1,908 million in the same period of 2025.

Palm Oil Rises on Export Strength, Firmer Edible Oils — Malaysian palm oil futures were notably higher, trading near MYR 4,720 per tonne and snapping recent losses, as firmer edible oil prices in Dalian and Chicago supported sentiment. Strong export demand added momentum, with a monthly report from the Malaysian Palm Oil Board showing July shipments up 14.5% from June to 1.39 million tonnes. Demand prospects in top buyer India also improved, as edible oil imports hit a 10-month high in July, with refiners stocking up on palm oil and soyoil ahead of the festive season. However, a stronger ringgit capped the gain. Meantime, Malaysia’s palm oil stocks rose 3.32% mom to 2.63 million tonnes in July, while production grew 9.41% to 1.79 million tonnes, highlighting ample near-term supply. In China, a key palm oil consumer, both CPI and PPI inflation eased in July, underscoring persistently weak domestic demand. Traders now await export estimates for August 1-10 from cargo surveyors after July shipments rose 12.1%-19.5% from June.

【Swiss National Bank hike timing pushed back; earliest now seen after June next year】Economists have delayed expectations for a Swiss National Bank rate rise; a monthly survey shows the earliest timing is now judged to be after June next year. Respondents who had expected borrowing costs to rise this year largely now see the SNB holding off until 2027, and a majority expect the first hike only in early 2028. The shift follows reports that SNB staff internally expect the policy rate to remain at 0% through end‑2027 and rise only thereafter, conditional on no new major shocks.

【Copper steadies after six-week rally as supply squeeze and cooling Fed rate-hike bets underpin prices】After a six-week rally, copper is trading in a narrow range as supply tightness and softer US rate-hike expectations keep prices elevated. LME copper topped $14,000/ton last week, reaching the highest level since late-January. Market expectations that the WHITE HOUSE will impose import tariffs have driven large copper flows into the US, tightening available supply elsewhere and supporting LME prices. Softer Fed tightening odds were reinforced by weaker-than-expected US jobs data on Friday, easing inf concerns and bolstering risk assets. CITIC Futures expects copper to remain elevated with heightened volatility in the near term.

Japan Services Sentiment Rises to 5-Month High — Japan’s services sector sentiment index rose to 45.7 in July 2026 from 44.0 in the previous month, reaching its highest level since February and exceeding market expectations of 44.0. The latest reading marked the third consecutive month of improvement, supported by stronger sentiment among household-related businesses, particularly those in the food and beverage sector. Corporate confidence also strengthened, led mainly by the non-manufacturing sector, while labor market conditions continued to firm. Meanwhile, the economic outlook index, which measures business expectations for the months ahead, edged up to 45.8 from 45.7 in June, hitting a five-month high and rising for a third straight month. The improvement suggested businesses expect economic conditions to stabilize despite lingering downward pressure from the Middle East conflict.

【Fujian ends typhoon emergency response; offshore production resumes】Fujian provincial flood control and drought relief headquarters terminated its typhoon emergency response at 12:00 on the 10th. Coastal and maritime and fisheries authorities are orderly restoring normal offshore production operations. To guard against Typhoon White Dolphin, authorities relocated 167,900 people from high‑risk areas. The headquarters warned residual circulation from the storm continues to bring rain to parts of Fujian and urged local departments to maintain defensive measures.

【聚力青年人才培育 2026國際基礎科學大會舉行】昨天（9日），2026國際基礎科學大會在北京開幕。本次大會主題為“聚焦基礎科學，引領人類未來”，共有千餘名中外科學家、科研工作者和青年學子參會，大會將持續到8月21日。在為期兩週的會議期間，將舉辦500餘場學術會議，涉及基礎科學各個分支與交叉方向，同時覆蓋生成式大模型推理、計算機視覺、人機互動、量子資訊等前沿熱點。多位國際頂尖科學家將領銜主講基礎科學報告、前沿科學獎報告，分享各領域最新突破性成果。（央視）

【九識智慧生產製造基地專案落戶海口國家高新區】據海南日報，近日，海口國家高新區管委會與九識智慧科技有限公司在海口進行交流座談，並正式簽署合作協議，標誌著九識智慧生產製造基地專案落戶海口國家高新區。據悉，九識智慧生產製造基地專案選址於高新區美安科技新城康迪基地，計劃總投資約1億元，分兩期建設。首期擬委託園區生產製造企業承接年產2000臺功能型無人車本地生產任務；二期將選取約1萬平方米合適廠房及測試場自建產線，全面達產後預計年產1萬臺無人車產品，實現年產值約3億元。專案落地後，將充分聯動海南自貿港政策優勢，打造面向華南及東南亞市場的智慧物流裝備生產樞紐。

【福建終止防颱風應急響應 海上生產作業陸續恢復】福建省防汛抗旱指揮部於10日12時終止防颱風應急響應。沿海各地及海洋與漁業部門正有序組織，恢復海上正常生產作業。防禦颱風“白海豚”，福建省轉移危險區域人員16.79萬人。福建省防指提醒，受颱風殘餘環流影響，當前福建省部分地區仍有降雨，各地各有關部門要善始善終做好各項防禦工作。
【北京釋出地質災害氣象風險橙色預警】北京市規劃和自然資源委聯合市氣象局於2026年8月10日10時提前釋出地質災害氣象風險橙色預警：預警生效時間為8月11日20時至8月12日20時，我市西部山區發生崩塌、滑坡、泥石流等地質災害的風險高（橙色預警）；北部山區發生崩塌、滑坡、泥石流等地質災害的風險較高（黃色預警），請注意防範。

【巴克萊：日本央行料將在9月而非10月加息】巴克萊的兩名經濟學家表示，日本央行料將在9月而不是10月加息，與此同時，他們將加息預期提前。這些經濟學家表示，今天釋出的日本央行7月30日至31日會議的意見摘要“整體聽起來比植田和男行長的言論更偏緊縮，並給人一種印象，即決策者對在9月會議上決定加息持積極態度“。巴克萊目前預計日本央行將加息三次：分別在2026年9月、2027年1月和2027年7月，終端利率為1.75%，而此前的預測是在10月和4月加息兩次，終端利率為1.5%。

【券商加強新開戶稽核、加大兩融審查力度？多家回應：合規要求一貫嚴格 不存在“從嚴”】今日有報道訊息稱，包括中信證券、東方財富在內的多家券商近期收緊新開戶稽核及兩融、期權交易審查。記者從中信證券、東方財富方面瞭解到，兩公司融資融券及衍生品業務合規要求一直是嚴格且規範的，不存在所謂“從嚴”，兩公司強調相關業務始終在監管框架下平穩執行。此外，就上述報道中提到的“7月下旬越來越多散戶被迫平倉離場”的說法，記者從行業瞭解到，多家券商信用業務已在各個業務環節逐一化解風險，客戶自身也主動補充保證金，市場整體風險可控。（財聯社）

【高盛：中國AI板塊不存在整體泡沫 三大細分領域最具投資價值】近期，伴隨著對人工智慧（AI）基建鉅額投資持續性以及相關股票高估值的擔憂，全球AI板塊持續震盪，以半導體為代表的AI概念股已較高點大幅回撥。在此背景下，高盛的一位資深策略師日前表示，中國AI板塊並不存在整體性泡沫，近期的市場走勢已使估值迴歸健康水平。他看好三大細分賽道的投資機會。高盛首席中國股票策略師劉勁津在接受媒體採訪時表示，中國AI相關股票的總市值，尚未充分反映這項技術將為整體經濟帶來的潛在紅利。劉勁津承認，6 月A股市場確實出現區域性過熱行情——當時科創板與創業板部分AI硬體公司估值一度觸及五年高點，但眼下股價與未來盈利增長預期已重新迴歸平衡，估值水平趨於 “合理健康”。目前，中國AI企業約佔全球AI板塊總市值的11%，但海外資金AI投資組合中配置到中國AI板塊的倉位佔比僅約1%。這表明，高盛認為，外資對中國AI股的低配程度仍非常高。高盛認為，中國三大AI相關細分領域最具投資價值：電力供應鏈、硬體基礎設施、以及物理AI。

【搜狐2026年Q2總收入1.36億美元，同比增長7%】8月10日，搜狐公司公佈了截至2026年6月30日未經審計的第二季度財務報告。搜狐公司第二季度總收入為1.36億美元，較2025年同期增長7%。其中，營銷服務收入為1500萬美元，線上遊戲收入為1.16億美元。財報顯示，歸於搜狐公司的非美國通用會計準則淨利潤為50萬美元，其中包含沖銷所得稅費用約1300萬美元。相比之下，2025年同期淨虧損為2000萬美元。

【匯天工廠第1000套電推進單元下線】據“匯天企業資訊號”訊息，8月10日，匯天飛行汽車量產工廠陸地航母飛行器第1000套電推進單元正式下線，創全球eVTOL行業800V電推進單元超大規模生產紀錄。此次陸地航母飛行器第1000套電推進單元下線，標誌著匯天已具備飛行器核心動力部件規模化、標準化生產能力。

【俄羅斯考慮設立100億盧布農產品出口鐵路補貼】俄新報援引知悉該計劃的匿名訊息人士報道，俄羅斯或劃撥約100億盧布（摺合1.214億美元），用於補貼農產品出口鐵路運輸。因亞速海通航條件受限，俄政府正起草相關法規以保障貨運出口。該補貼或將助力貨物從羅斯托夫地區轉向黑海、波羅的海運輸線路，同時推動西伯利亞貨源轉至遠東港口外運。諮詢機構Neo測算，截至8月1日，將亞速‑黑海流域出口貨物改道波羅的海，每噸將增加35‑50美元成本。今日早些時候，受黑海供應擾動影響，小麥價格創下一週新高。

【英媒：X平臺成極右翼製造輿論對立的武器】英國媒體《衛報》9日報道，關於英國6月發生的兩起騷亂事件，美國企業家馬斯克旗下社交媒體平臺X上流量最高的帖文有相當數量源自美國賬號，該平臺已成為外國極右翼勢力製造輿論對立的武器。6月8日，英國北愛爾蘭首府貝爾法斯特發生一起惡性持刀襲擊事件，嫌疑人為一名蘇丹裔男子。案發後，記錄襲擊過程的影片在社交媒體上廣泛傳播，極右翼人士煽風點火，引發巨大震動。貝爾法斯特隨後發生“打砸搶”，至少12名警員受傷。同月，在英格蘭南部城市南安普敦，也發生一起嫌疑人為印度裔的兇殺案，當地反移民情緒被點燃，爆發大規模騷亂。在這兩起事件後的輿論動盪中，社交媒體均起到推波助瀾的作用。《衛報》的分析資料顯示，在X平臺釋出兩地騷亂內容、且單帖瀏覽量破千的8672個賬號中，45.3%的網路IP地址在英國，16.8%位於美國；瀏覽量最高的12條帖文中有7條來自美國賬號，其中一條由馬斯克本人發出。馬斯克在那條帖文中寫道：“過時的主流媒體，那些寫喬治·弗洛伊德寫了數百萬次的媒體，而今就諾瓦克（遇害）一聲不吭。”這條帖文的瀏覽量超過2800萬次。（新華社）

【通用汽車中國：雪佛蘭未來將繼續在中國生產，出口全球】8月10日，針對雪佛蘭品牌未來發展，通用汽車中國方面向記者回應稱：合資企業將繼續在中國生產雪佛蘭產品，並積極探索在美國以外的海外市場機遇。企業將為雪佛蘭車主提供售後保障。 企業方面表示：我們的合資企業將繼續在中國生產雪佛蘭產品，並積極探索在美國以外的海外市場機遇。雪佛蘭也將繼續保持通用汽車全球銷量最大品牌的地位。通用汽車中國認為：在中國，凱迪拉克與別克在各自的細分市場中具備良好的競爭優勢，能夠支援業務的可持續增長；而合資企業旗下的雪佛蘭產品線則最契合我們的出口市場需求。 此前，有報道稱，通用汽車在中國子品牌雪佛蘭或將退出中國市場。（貝殼財經）

South Korean Won Eases From Over 10-Month High — The South Korean won eased to around 1,415 per dollar, pulling back slightly from a recent over ten-month high, as renewed uncertainty over the Strait of Hormuz weighed on the currency. Iran denied holding direct talks with Washington over reopening the waterway, casting doubt on a near-term deal and keeping oil prices elevated, raising concerns over import costs and inflation in South Korea. Meanwhile, strong semiconductor exports and continued dollar selling by exporters provided support, with July exports rising nearly 63% year-on-year to $98.89 billion and semiconductor shipments surging 179%. Expectations of foreign exchange intervention by South Korean authorities are also helping limit renewed won weakness and keep the currency near its strongest level since October 2025. At the same time, investors are monitoring this week's US inflation data for further clues on the Federal Reserve's policy outlook and the dollar's direction.

【日本電價在假期來臨前降至7月以來最低水平】受天氣預報氣溫轉涼、週二法定假日及本月晚些時候暑期假期帶來用電需求回落影響，日本現貨電力價格跌至7月初以來最低水平。日本電力交易所資料顯示，該國次日期全國電力價格週一環比下跌41%，報11.37日元/千瓦時。日本氣象廳與商業氣象機構維薩拉預測，東京及整個關東‑甲信地區本週末至下週初天氣趨於溫和，此間氣溫略低於常年均值。日本氣象廳預報，截至週日，東京日間最高氣溫28‑30攝氏度。關西地區未來數日也將迎來短暫降溫時段。本田、日產等主要製造企業將暫停生產，一方面源於8月8日開啟的暑期休假，另一方面熊本地震對零部件供應造成衝擊。日本盂蘭盆節暑期假期通常在8月中旬。

【ADNOC Gas上半年營收71.46億美元，同比下降23.38%】8月10日，阿布扎比國家石油公司天然氣業務子公司ADNOC Gas釋出了截至2026年6月30日止的2026年上半年及第二季度財務業績報告。在2026年第二季度，ADNOC Gas實現營業收入31.11億美元，同比下降33.19%；實現淨利潤6.65億美元，同比下降52.03%；每股收益為0.009美元。從整個上半年來看，公司累計實現營業收入71.46億美元，同比下降23.38%；淨利潤為17.44億美元，同比下降34.31%。

Dutch Manufacturing Output Falls in June — Manufacturing production in the Netherlands fell 1.3% month-on-month in June 2026, following an upwardly revised 1.1% increase in May. This marked the first decline in manufacturing output since February, with production falling mainly in food (-4.8% vs. 1.0% in May), leather and footwear (-4.1% vs. 2.6%), electrical appliances (-1.9% vs. 0.5%), and machinery (-2.9% vs. 7.0%). Output also continued to decline in textiles (-0.2% vs. -0.5%), paper (-0.7% vs. -2.2%), rubber and plastics (-0.4% vs. -1.0%), and metal products (-1.6% vs. -2.4%). On a yearly basis, manufacturing production increased 4.6%, easing from a 6.8% rise in May. Output grew in nearly half of the underlying sectors, with the machinery industry once again recording the largest increase, while machine repair and installation posted the biggest decline.

【美國五角大樓要求軍工企業加速擴產，應對伊朗戰事彈藥告急】面對與伊朗持續戰事導致的關鍵彈藥庫存大幅下降，美國國防部近日採取緊急行動。美國《華盛頓郵報》8日獨家報道稱，五角大樓已向美國主要軍工企業發出指令，要求其加快武器生產，並在限期內提交擴大產能和加速交付的具體計劃。 據《華盛頓郵報》獲得的國防部備忘錄顯示，美國國防部副部長斯蒂芬·範伯格（Steve Feinberg）於本週三致函包括洛克希德·馬丁、雷神技術（RTX）、波音等在內的多家防務承包商負責人，明確要求企業在不超過21天的時間內，提交“顯著加快、更激進交付時間表和/或增加關鍵能力生產”的方案。 （觀察者網）

【阿聯酋Adnoc Gas將投資逾80億美元推進擴張】阿聯酋的Adnoc Gas表示，將投資逾80億美元提升產能。就在幾個月前，阿聯酋剛剛退出石油輸出國組織，此舉讓阿聯酋的阿布扎比酋長國擺脫了歐佩克的產量配額限制。Adnoc Gas由國營的阿布扎比國家石油公司控股，目前已是全球最大的天然氣生產商之一。眼下，該公司正押注一項大規模增長計劃，以滿足人口激增和高耗能資料中心帶來的不斷攀升的天然氣需求。阿聯酋正開足馬力提高石油產量，意在進一步鞏固其能源超級大國地位。Adnoc Gas則負責為國內和國際市場加工天然氣和液化天然氣(LNG)。根據週一公佈的計劃，Adnoc Gas將在該國最大的天然氣加工設施哈布尚(Habshan)新建一個國內天然氣加工裝置。此外，該公司還將在魯韋斯(Ruwais)新建一個天然氣出口設施。上述舉措是富天然氣開發(Rich Gas Development)專案的一部分。Adnoc Gas希望藉此獲取高利潤率的天然氣，將其轉化為優質產品，從而拉動利潤增長。

【銅價守住14000美元關口，美國利率前景提振金屬板塊】在連續六週上漲後，銅價陷入窄幅震盪，供給收緊以及市場對美國加息的擔憂降溫為行情提供支撐。上週銅價突破每噸14000美元，觸及1月末大幅衝高以來的盤中最高位。市場預判白宮將出臺進口關稅，大量銅金屬流入美國，造成其他地區供應縮減，推高倫敦金屬交易所銅價。市場對美聯儲今年加息的預期不斷消退，同樣利好銅價。上週五美國就業資料不及預期，通脹憂慮得到緩解，風險資產由此迎來做多情緒。利率走高會壓制全球經濟，進而對金屬價格形成衝擊。中信期貨在研報中表示：“短期銅價預計維持高位且波動劇烈。”銅價報每噸14080美元，基本持平；鋁價上漲0.5%，鋅價下跌0.3%。新加坡鐵礦石期貨下跌0.2%，報每噸94.55美元。
【恆工精密、智元機器人等成立新公司 含多項AI業務】企查查APP顯示，近日，恆智科（蘇州）科技有限公司成立，經營範圍包含人工智慧基礎資源與技術平臺；人工智慧通用應用系統；人工智慧公共服務平臺技術諮詢服務；服務消費機器人制造；智慧機器人的研發等。企查查股權穿透顯示，該公司由恆工精密全資子公司恆工偉創具身智慧科技（上海）有限公司、智元機器人關聯公司智元創新（上海）科技股份有限公司等共同持股。
【上半年廣東結婚登記28.8萬對】日前，廣東省民政廳官網釋出廣東民政事業統計季報（2026年第二季度）。統計季報顯示，今年上半年，廣東結婚登記28.8萬對、離婚登記10.8萬對。從各地市情況來看，今年上半年，廣州、深圳、佛山、東莞等市結婚登記量超過2萬對。其中，深圳57181對、廣州52435對、東莞23855對、佛山21691對。

【財通福鑫定開混合：將於8月10日下午開盤起至當日收盤停牌】財通基金管理有限公司公告，截至2026年8月10日上海證券交易所午間收盤，旗下財通多策略福鑫定期開放靈活配置混合型發起式證券投資基金（場內簡稱：財通福鑫定開混合，交易程式碼：501046）二級市場交易價格嚴重高於基金份額淨值，出現極大幅度溢價。特此提示投資者關注二級市場交易價格溢價風險，投資者如果盲目投資，可能遭受重大損失。為維護投資者利益，本基金將於2026年8月10日下午開盤起至當日收盤停牌。

【ESA director warns Europe could face launch‑vehicle shortage around 2030】European Space Agency Director Joseph Aschbacher warned Europe could face a domestic launch‑vehicle shortage around 2030 as satellite launch demand rises. ESA is assessing future launch needs and projects total launch requirements from current and planned constellations and missions will peak around 2029–2031. Aschbacher said he will raise the issue with ESA member states to ensure Europe can use domestically produced rockets to meet demand.

【受黑海地區供應中斷影響 小麥價格創一週新高】受黑海航運受阻，這一重要糧食產區或出現供應短缺影響，美國小麥期貨漲至一週多以來最高水平。因俄烏衝突帶來安全風險加劇，土耳其上週末暫停本國船隻在黑海通行。土耳其外長哈坎・菲丹呼籲該地區實施襲擊“暫停令”。此前烏克蘭於週五釋出公告稱，受俄羅斯襲擊影響，其2026‑2027銷售年度農產品出口量或將較此前預期下滑超半數。烏克蘭政府表示，烏克蘭是全球主要農產品出口國之一，糧食可供給約4億人口。芝加哥交投最活躍的小麥期貨週一最大漲幅達1.8%，創下7月30日以來新高，帶動整個穀物板塊上行。硬紅冬小麥合約漲幅更為迅猛，主力合約最高上漲2.4%。

【高溫催熱避暑遊 “清涼目的地”航線機票量同比增長超5倍】這個暑期，避暑遊成為不少人出行的重要主題。記者在多家線上旅遊預訂平臺上發現，西南、西北、華北及東北等方向的清涼目的地客流顯著增長，部分“追涼”航線旅客機票量同比增長超過5倍。記者梳理多家平臺大資料發現，7月西北方向，德令哈、巴里坤等地到達客流同比增幅均超150%；華北方向，張家口到達客流同比增長約170%。此外，記者發現在鄰近貴州的雲南，東南亞遊客正在掀起“避暑熱”，帶動麗江、昆明等目的地熱度快速攀升。線上旅遊預訂平臺大資料顯示，7月麗江入境遊預訂量同比增長1.2倍，其中越南遊客赴麗江、昆明的增幅分別達4.5倍和2.4倍，新加坡及馬來西亞遊客赴雲南的機票預訂量增長超四成。（央視）

Sensex Begins Week Lower — India’s BSE Sensex fell about 0.2% to 78,348 on Monday, extending losses from the previous session as investors weighed rising oil prices against easing expectations for a near-term US Federal Reserve rate hike. Investor sentiment received some support from weaker-than-expected US jobs data, which reduced expectations of an imminent Fed Reserve rate hike. The positive global backdrop was partly offset by higher crude prices. Brent crude rose around $84.5 a barrel as uncertainty over the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz continued. Traders will also be watching how the new closing auction behaves as the market enters another week of trading. Among stocks, Titan will be in focus after a sharp rise in quarterly profit, while Dr. Reddy’s ended its distribution agreement with Novartis India. Oil India’s profit more than tripled, while Ola Electric narrowed its first-quarter loss. Top losers were State Bank of India (-1.6%), Kaynes (-1.5%), Cupid (-0.5%), and Hindalco (-0.5%).

【CPI溫和上漲！紅利低波ETF華泰柏瑞（512890）近5年回報超62％ 機構建議作為底倉配置】8月10日，A股三大指數分化震盪，截至午間收盤，滬指漲0.20％，創指跌2.18％。在此背景下，紅利低波ETF華泰柏瑞（512890）漲0.86％，報1.168元，換手率1.52％，半日成交額4.92億元，居同類標的ETF首位。訊息面上，國家統計局近日釋出資料顯示，7月份居民消費價格指數（CPI）環比下降0.1％，同比上漲0.5％，扣除食品和能源價格的核心CPI環比上漲0.3％，同比上漲0.9％，CPI總體保持溫和上漲；工業生產者出廠價格指數（PPI）環比下降0.7％，同比上漲3.5％，漲幅比6月份回落0.6個百分點。華泰證券表示，展望後市，超跌反彈仍有演繹空間，重點關注創業板指。節奏上，8月中下旬的中報密集期或是檢驗反彈成色的視窗。配置上，錨定中報均衡配置。中期視角下，價效比出海鏈及必需消費處於增配視窗。紅利底倉繼續持有，結構上，重點配置銀行與交運。國信證券指出，A股高景氣行業股價頂部往往呈現“M頂”形態，這一次科技行情或也不例外。M頂第二波機會需要產業層面分歧消除且擁擠度回落，目前AI科技M頂第二波行情的啟動因素正在累積。擾動後A股牛途繼續，結構上均衡佈局，成長或向AI應用擴散，重視紅利，以及基本面較優的醫藥券商、受益政策的內需。投資者可將紅利低波ETF華泰柏瑞（512890）作為底倉配置，無股票賬戶的投資者也可透過其場外聯接基金進行配置（A類：007466；C類：007467；I類：022678；Y類：022951）。

【法巴：亞洲料將抵禦潛在的AI投資放緩】法國巴黎銀行亞太區市場策略師Chi Lo表示，亞洲將能夠抵禦潛在的AI投資放緩。自6月底以來，主要AI相關股票的拋售引發了亞洲投資者的擔憂，因為強勁的資本支出一直是該地區增長前景的關鍵驅動力。不過，Lo認為，可再生能源轉型、能源安全投資和國防支出將支援AI和半導體以外的工業和資本支出。強勁的資本支出也反映在強勁的資本貨物進口和處於多年高位的工業增長指標上。該地區的企業資產負債表保持健康，近40%的亞洲（除日本外）公司淨現金為正。法國巴黎銀行表示，市場預計2027年至2031年該地區的資本支出將以16%的複合年增長率增長。

【泰國學校設金屬探測器防再出槍擊案】今天（8月10日），泰國曼谷市中心的一些學校加強了安保措施，包括設定金屬探測器進行安檢。上週五（8月7日），曼谷以北暖武裡府的一所中學發生槍擊事件。一名14歲的學生在家殺害祖父母后，又帶槍進入校園，殺害了至少6人，打傷20多人，隨後飲彈自盡。警方稱，槍手使用了其祖父的一把手槍，至少射擊了26發子彈，現場還發現了另外34發子彈。這是自2022年以來泰國最嚴重的群體性槍擊事件。這起慘劇再次引發了人們對這個東南亞最大擁槍國槍支管控的討論。泰國總理阿努廷在案發後表示，政府擬提議一項新的槍支管控方案來限制公眾攜帶槍支，“相關部門必須加強監管槍支援有情況，除執行公務，無論是政府官員還是普通民眾，不得攜槍支進入公共場所”。（CCTV國際時訊）

【颱風減弱≠影響結束！警惕“三碰頭”疊加風險】“白海豚”雖已減弱為熱帶風暴級，但影響遠未結束。福建省海峽氣象科學研究所副所長、高階工程師陳思提醒，需高度警惕颱風影響期間可能帶來的“三碰頭”疊加風險。何為“三碰頭”？“三碰頭”也叫“風雨潮三碰頭”，指的是颱風帶來的強風、暴雨與天文大潮在相近時間、同一沿海區域疊加出現的極端情況。陳思解釋，風、雨、潮三者本就各有威力，一旦“碰頭”，破壞力將呈幾何級放大。“三碰頭”的危害主要體現為：狂風肆虐，破壞力極強；暴雨傾盆，洪澇風險陡增；潮位頂託，海水倒灌風險高。（央視）

【安本投資：9月加息與否機率相若 不排除美聯儲為顯示抗通脹決心而加息】安本投資亞洲固定收益高階投資經理邴竹君接受媒體專訪時認為，現時加息與不加息的機率相若，但不排除美聯儲為展示其抗通脹的決心，被迫在9月加息。邴竹君表示，美聯儲於最近一次會議維持利率不變，但有3位委員支援加息，說明美聯儲內部對通脹風險存在分歧，目前9月加息與不加息的比例很接近，但仍要留意油價、通脹資料及中東局勢的發展。邴竹君表示，“如果通脹壓力大、沒有緩和跡象，霍爾木茲海峽持續封閉，油價反彈到90美元甚至100美元以上，加息的機會將進一步提升。目前中東局勢反覆，海峽那邊也比較緊張，能源價格有可能進一步提升。”

【健世科技-B預計中期收入同比增加385%至400%】健世科技-B(09877)釋出公告，集團預期截至2026年6月30日止六個月實現收入人民幣約6300萬元至6500萬元，同比增加385%至400%。其他收入及收益人民幣約900萬至1100萬元，共計人民幣約7200萬至7600萬元，與上年同期相比，將增加人民幣4700萬元至5100萬元，同比增加188%至204%。報告期間業績增長的主要原因包括：1.集團經導管人工主動脈瓣膜系統Ken-Valve商業化持續實現穩健收入增長。Ken-Valve可適用於主動脈瓣反流或合併狹窄，其產品設計特點及操作效能的優勢使得術式快速在多層級醫療機構推廣應用;2.集團多款結構性心臟病介入類產品積極於海外開展收費臨床植入。產品的良好臨床效果和應用優勢獲得全球關鍵意見領袖及專家的高度評價，可滿足全球龐大的結構性心臟病長期未被滿足的臨床需求。
【河北釋出暴雨橙色預警】河北省氣象臺2026年8月10日10時12分發布暴雨橙色預警訊號：預計11日下午到12日夜間，保定、廊坊及以南大部分地區累計降水量在100毫米以上，其中保定西部、石家莊西部、邢臺、邯鄲的部分地區降水量可達150～350毫米，邢臺、邯鄲的個別地點可能超過400毫米。山區及淺山區有出現山洪、泥石流、滑坡等次生災害的風險，低窪地區有積水風險，請注意防範。

Rupee Holds as RBI Cushions Oil Pressure — The Indian rupee hovered around 95.2 per dollar, holding steady after recent gains as continued Reserve Bank of India intervention and reduced expectations of a September Federal Reserve rate hike provided support. The rupee has been in recovery mode over the past two weeks, aided by regular RBI intervention. Brent crude rose to around $84.50 a barrel on Monday but remained well below its recent high of $100, providing some breathing room for the rupee. The RBI also intervened at the open on Friday, signalling its willingness to prevent oil-price uncertainty from translating into unchecked pressure on the currency. Meanwhile, investors pared bets on a September Fed rate hike after US employers unexpectedly shed 23,000 jobs in July, with Fed funds futures now implying a 44% probability of a hike, down from 55% before the data. The RBI's continued presence in the foreign exchange market has helped cushion the rupee from oil-related pressure and limit downside risks.

【港股藥王盤中市值突破6000億港元】8月10日上午，港股市場開盤後，港股市值最高的藥企藥明康德盤中股價持續創歷史新高，一度達到204.2港元/股，市值一度突破6000億港元。 與此同時，同樣是A股市值最高的藥企藥明康德盤中股價一度達到166.66元/股，距離上次歷史高點166.83元/股也僅有一步之遙。

【機構：印尼央行第四季度可能加息】聯昌國際將其對印尼央行利率的預期從按兵不動修正為第四季度加息25個基點，這反映出與厄爾尼諾現象相關的食品供應受干擾和能源價格高企帶來的通脹風險。聯昌國際分析師表示，2026年通脹率可能達到3.4%，接近印尼央行目標區間的上限。他們表示，財政空間預計將保持充足，因為較高的能源補貼帶來的影響可能會在很大程度上被優先專案的削減和更強勁的財政收入所抵消。他們認為，因此佔GDP 2.85%的財政赤字目標預計將保持不變，儘管下半年政府支出可能增加會帶來上行風險。聯昌國際補充道，增強的流動性激勵措施應會緩解資金壓力，但信貸傳導可能依然有限，隨著銀行繼續將過剩流動性配置於印尼央行證券。
US senior defense official Colby said US interests in the Indo-Pacific are closer than ever, meaning US investment in the region will be stronger and is increasing.
穆迪將松下評級上調至A3，展望穩定。

【上海青浦區啟動防汛防颱Ⅰ級響應，青浦南門水位已達3.84米】從上海青浦區獲悉，目前上海青浦南門水位已達3.84米，超保證水位，根據《青浦區防汛防颱專項應急預案》，經區政府同意，區防汛專項指揮部決定於2026年8月10日11時10分將全區防汛防颱II級響應更新為全區防汛防颱Ⅰ級響應行動。請各街鎮、各單位做好應對防範工作，做好人員轉移安置、社會面保安全工作。當前，上海青浦區高掛大風橙色預警、暴雨橙色預警。（澎湃）
【英國監管機構正著手製定代幣化黃金框架】英國《金融時報》不具名援引知情人士報道，英國監管機構正著手製定代幣化黃金監管框架，作為推動金融市場數字化以及維護倫敦全球黃金交易中心地位計劃的一部分。英國金融行為監管局已就代幣化黃金的監管方式與行業機構展開討論，其中包括多家大型銀行。未來數月，監管部門預計將宣佈制定這一領域監管標準的相關計劃。
【印度阿薩姆邦洪災已致100人死亡】印度阿薩姆邦政府9日釋出公告稱，阿薩姆邦的洪災形勢依然嚴峻。截至9日當天，本輪洪災已經導致100人死亡。報告稱，有近14萬人仍然受到災情影響。阿薩姆邦災害管理局稱，受洪水影響，456個村莊被淹，11933公頃農田遭到破壞。洪水還損毀了多個地區的堤壩、道路、橋樑和其他基礎設施。目前有近5萬名受災民眾在避難所生活。

【上海浙江多地降雨量破紀錄】中央氣象臺8月10日介紹，受颱風“白海豚”影響，從8日起，強降雨主要出現在浙江、江蘇、上海、安徽等地，區域最大累計降水量815.7毫米（浙江台州），平均降水量最大省份為上海，其次為浙江，共有5個站點日降水量突破歷史極值。 中國天氣首席氣象分析師信欣表示，今晨6時至7時，江蘇崑山降雨69.9毫米破當地觀測史單小時雨量紀錄；7時至8時江蘇金壇降雨74.6毫米，破當地8月單小時降雨量紀錄；8時至9時江蘇無錫降雨53.3毫米，雨勢也非常強。 從9日到10日早晨，浙江、上海多地出現大暴雨到特大暴雨。區域自動站裡，浙江台州和寧波下屬區域，降雨量超500毫米；台州的視頭村降雨最強，達到648.3毫米。 在國家級氣象站中，上海徐家彙316.1毫米、浙江溫嶺425毫米、三門367.8毫米、台州椒江區299毫米、臨海283.9毫米、永嘉268.6毫米、寧海259毫米，共有7站出現特大暴雨。 而在浙江溫嶺、三門、景寧、徐家彙、浦東、青浦，這6個站點打破了1951年以來最強單日降水量紀錄。另外，上海浙江還有15個站點，打破了8月同期最大單日降水量紀錄。 同時，受颱風“白海豚”影響，8月9日，浙江東部多地出現了12級以上的大風。其中，浙江台州玉環鮮迭、臨海北澤島，陣風超60米/秒，出現了17級大風。 信欣表示，11日，“白海豚”繼續在內陸上向西北方向移動，強度會進一步減弱，風的影響會明顯減小，但降雨的影響依然巨大。（北京日報）

【干預效應消退下日元本月表現墊底 交易員提防官方再度出手】日元本月表現遜於所有G-10貨幣，近期干預帶來的提振作用逐漸消退，令交易員們提高警覺，提防官方再度出手。日元兌美元匯率8月以來下跌約0.5%，7月份3.2%的漲幅已經部分回吐。上週五公佈的美國非農業就業報告弱於預期，拖累美元，日元一度短暫反彈，但不久之後重拾跌勢。日本週二適逢假期，交易員也擔心流動性趨緊，可能為新一輪干預創造條件。儘管美日先前歷史性的聯合干預，但鑑於日元面臨許多不利因素，例如擔憂日本可能增加財政支出，日元疲軟的局面似乎仍將持續。野村證券的Yujiro Goto等策略師在報告中寫道，日本將進入盂蘭盆節假期，可能限制市場參與，而國內事件日程也相對清淡。市場焦點仍將放在日本與美國當局對干預的立場，投資人將密切關注官員們的發言。

【Hong Kong midday: Hang Seng up 0.72% after choppy session; innovative drug and livestock stocks lead】Hang Seng rose 0.72% to 25,853.69 at midday after an early gap higher that briefly added more than 200 points and brought the index back above its 250-day moving average; the Hang Seng Tech index briefly gave back gains before noon and was up 0.37% at 4,876.20. Market turnover hit HK$140.8 billion. Livestock and innovative-drug names led gains, with gold, coal and consumer sectors also outperforming; storage, optical communications and semiconductor/compute-hardware-related sectors lagged. Guotai Junan International (01788.HK) resumed trading and jumped 36.3% after Guotai Haitong (02611.HK) proposed a take‑private at about a 44.2% premium. Wuxi AppTec (02359.HK) closed up 2.86% after an intraday record high of HK$204.20. Muyuan Foods (02714.HK) rose 4.18%, Chifeng Gold (06693.HK) gained 3.09%; GigaDevice (03986.HK) fell 6.17% and Hua Hong Semiconductor (01347.HK) dropped 3.05%.

Financial Times reports UK defence group Cambridge Aerospace has raised $300m to develop missile and drone interception systems, valuing the company at $3.4bn and cementing its position as one of the UK's most valuable startups.

【German economy minister warns AfD rise could deter investors】Economy Minister Katherina Reiche warned the far‑right Alternative for Germany (AfD)'s rising support could deter potential investors, saying the party's platform appears anti–market and lacks a coherent economic policy. Germany is seeking to attract at least €3.75 trillion in private capital by 2040 and will hold its first investment summit in Berlin in October. Recent polls show the AfD may win an absolute majority in the September state election in Saxony‑Anhalt. The head of the Federation of German Industries said AfD participation in state government would be disastrous, creating uncertainty and weakening Germany's appeal as an investment destination.
【中國神華在內蒙古成立煤炭技術研究院公司】企查查APP顯示，近日，國能（內蒙古）煤炭技術研究院有限公司成立，註冊資本10億元，經營範圍包含工程和技術研究和試驗發展；規劃設計管理；碳減排、碳轉化、碳捕捉、碳封存技術研發等。企查查股權穿透顯示，該公司由中國神華全資持股。

【海南：支援“投貸聯動” 重點培育一批具有影響力的創業投資機構】海南省人民政府辦公廳近日印發《海南省關於進一步深化投融資改革的若干舉措》，其中提出，提升創業投資便利化。支援“投貸聯動”，重點培育一批具有影響力的創業投資機構；鼓勵銀行機構加強與創業投資機構合作，為企業提供“股權+債權”全生命週期金融服務。符合條件的外商投資企業從事創業投資，依法依規享受相關稅收優惠政策，吸引境內外知名創業投資機構落戶。
英國導彈與無人機攔截器初創企業劍橋航空航天公司以34億美元的估值融資3億美元。

【天津發布暴雨橙色預警】天津市氣象臺於2026年8月10日10時43分發布暴雨橙色預警訊號：預計8月11日夜間至13日白天，天津市有暴雨，大部分地區累計雨量70-100毫米，薊州、武清、西青、靜海、濱海新區南部區域性100-150毫米，個別點累計雨量可達200毫米以上，主要降雨時段在12日。強降雨易引發城市積澇，山區及淺山區有發生中小河流洪水、山洪、地質災害的風險，低窪地區易發生農田漬澇，請有關單位和人員做好防範準備。

【北京君正二闖港交所，已透過港交所聆訊】8月10日，據港交所披露的資訊顯示，北京君正積體電路股份有限公司更新聆訊後資料集，該公司港交所IPO透過聆訊，獨家保薦人為國泰君安國際。公司於今年5月26日再次向香港聯交所遞交主機板上市申請。此前，公司已於6月24日收到中國證監會出具的境外發行上市備案通知書，核准其發行不超過61658000股境外上市普通股並在港交所上市。招股書顯示，北京君正是一家全球化的“儲存+計算+模擬”晶片提供商，產品廣泛應用於汽車電子、工業醫療、AIoT及智慧安防裝置。
【上海市藥品監督管理局批准註冊28項醫療器械產品】上海市藥品監督管理局批准註冊28項醫療器械產品。
【菲律賓稱山體滑坡和洪水已造成12人死亡】菲律賓當局稱，持續不斷的季風暴雨引發山體滑坡和洪水，已造成至少12人死亡，另有8人失蹤。

【Indonesian stocks near bull‑market territory as economic worries ease】Indonesian equities rose on Monday, with the Jakarta Composite Index up as much as 0.8% and roughly 20% higher from its early‑June low, bringing it close to conventional bull‑market territory. PT Bank Central Asia and PT Merdeka Copper Gold were the largest contributors. Stronger‑than‑expected economic data and President Subianto’s plan to scale back an ambitious free‑meal program eased investor concerns about fiscal strain. MSCI’s June decision to postpone a country‑index review and S&P Global Ratings’ decision to maintain Indonesia’s sovereign rating also helped stabilise the market.

【自然資源部對河北河南湖北啟動地質災害防禦Ⅳ級響應】據氣象部門預測和自然資源部地質災害技術指導中心研判，受今年第13號颱風“白海豚”影響，未來三天，河北、河南、湖北有強降雨過程，河北南部、河南西部和北部、湖北西部等部分地區發生地質災害的風險較高。自然資源部於8月10日9時對河北、河南、湖北啟動地質災害防禦Ⅳ級響應。自然資源部要求河北、河南、湖北省自然資源主管部門增強風險意識和憂患意識，強化底線思維和極限思維，高度重視強降雨引發地質災害防範應對，及時組織開展巡查排查，切實做好監測預警、會商研判、災情險情處置和值班值守、資訊報送等工作；中國地質調查局、自然資源部地質災害技術指導中心加強會商研判和專家排程，全力協助地方做好地質災害防禦工作。（央視新聞）

【海南：支援上市公司依託海南自貿港政策優勢最佳化產業發展佈局】海南省人民政府辦公廳近日印發《海南省關於進一步深化投融資改革的若干舉措》，其中提出，推動上市公司擴容與存量提質。堅持存量提質與增量擴容並重，結合地方實際，最佳化上市公司發展生態，推動省內優質企業根據自身特點在境內合適板塊上市，支援上市公司依託海南自貿港政策優勢最佳化產業發展佈局。支援上市公司透過併購重組、再融資做優做強。依託區域股權市場平臺功能，為優質中小企業提供全生命週期的資本市場服務。

【海南：最佳化資金組合並推動科技領域“先投後股”】海南省人民政府辦公廳近日印發《海南省關於進一步深化投融資改革的若干舉措》，其中提出，最佳化資金組合並推動科技領域“先投後股”。統籌政府資金與政策性金融工具、商業銀行貸款投放節奏，推動政策性銀行、商業銀行提前介入重大專案謀劃，設定政府資金、信貸資金、自有資金合理配比，探索建立“資金效率化、投資基金化、建設信貸化、運營證券化”的全週期資金迴圈體系，對於收益較好、融資渠道寬的專案，減少安排或不安排政府資金。制定科技系統‌財政資金“先投後股”操作指引，擴大“先投後股”範圍，對生物醫藥、深海科技等成果轉化專案，財政資金可先行投入，待企業成熟後轉為股權，實現風險共擔、利益共享。

【颱風減弱≠風險消退 多地路網仍面臨嚴峻考驗】颱風“白海豚”昨天下午以強颱風級在浙江玉環登陸，後在溫州樂清二次登陸。目前臺風“白海豚”雖然已經減弱，但是颱風帶來的風險並沒有消退，今天多地的交通路網依然受到颱風和強降雨的影響。颱風本體強度已經明顯減弱，但它環流體量依舊龐大，強降雨仍在持續擴散，多地路網仍然面臨嚴峻的保通、保暢壓力。記者從路網中心瞭解到，截至今天早上9時，受颱風影響，浙江、安徽、福建、上海等4省國省幹線共有61個路段採取主動封閉管控措施。（央視）
市場訊息：英國監管機構正為代幣化黃金制定監管框架。

【港股午評：恒生指數漲0.72％，恒生科技指數漲0.37％】港股午間收盤，恒生指數漲0.72％，恒生科技指數漲0.37％。板塊方面，焦炭加工Ⅲ、焦炭加工Ⅳ板塊漲幅靠前；調查和諮詢服務、環保裝置板塊跌幅靠前。個股方面，國泰君安國際漲36.3％，晶泰控股漲9.47％，禮邦醫藥-B漲9.18％，力量發展漲8.95％，老鋪黃金漲8.52％；建滔積層板跌10.43％，深圳國際跌10.41％，偉祿科技股份跌10.19％，珞石機器人跌9.19％，天數智芯跌8.11％。
【葵花葯業投資成立醫藥公司】企查查APP顯示，近日，四川葵花醫藥有限公司成立，法定代表人為戴瑞全，註冊資本為1000萬元，經營範圍包含：第一類醫療器械銷售；第二類醫療器械銷售；食品銷售（僅銷售預包裝食品）；保健食品（預包裝）銷售等。企查查股權穿透顯示，該公司由葵花葯業全資持股。

阿布扎比國家石油公司天然氣業務：宣佈已為魯韋斯‑達芙拉‑吉拉專案二期、三期授予總金額 82 億美元的工程總承包合同。三季度淨利潤預測基於霍爾木茲海峽海上航道持續受擾的假設。公司表示全年利潤預測的前提是第四季度海上作業完全恢復、產品實際售價迴歸正常。上半年國內天然氣銷售量下滑 20%，至 948 萬億英熱單位，主要因回注氣量減少。受 3 月起霍爾木茲海峽擾動並貫穿整個二季度的影響，出口及貿易液態產品銷量下滑 36%，至 319 萬億英熱單位，液化石油氣、石腦油、液化天然氣出口受限。受地區衝突影響，二季度把握市場高價的能力受限。已與客戶及合作伙伴密切協作，減輕擾動帶來的衝擊，應對階段性產能制約，儘可能履行各項合約義務。

【Hainan issues measures to deepen investment-financing reform】Hainan provincial government office issued measures to further reform investment and financing. The plan directs coordination of government funds, policy financial tools and commercial bank lending cadence, and urges policy banks and commercial lenders to join major-project planning earlier. It requires setting a balanced mix of government capital, credit and sponsor own funds and seeks to build a full-cycle capital recycling system—“fund efficiency, investment fund structure, credit-based construction, securitized operations.” Projects with strong returns and broad financing access should see reduced or no government funding. The measures also issue operational guidance to expand a “invest first, convert to equity later” model for science-and-technology fiscal funds; fiscal capital may initially finance commercialization projects (eg, biomedicine, deep-sea technology) and convert to equity once firms mature to share risk and returns.

Copper Pulls Back from Record Highs — Copper futures slipped below $6.6 per pound on Monday, retreating from record levels reached last week as traders took profits while weighing signs of tightening global supply. Concerns over potential supply disruptions from the Democratic Republic of Congo’s copper concentrate export ban also eased, with Goldman Sachs saying it expected the measure to have no significant impact on global copper balances. However, traders remained cautious over possible US import tariffs on copper, which continued to redirect metal from international markets into US warehouses. On the demand front, data released over the weekend showed both consumer and producer inflation in top consumer China slowed in July, pointing to persistently weak domestic demand. Data on Friday also showed China’s imports of unwrought copper and copper products dropped 11.5% year on year to 425,000 tonnes in July, while imports for January-July fell 6.2% to 2.92 million tonnes.

【China Satcom joins MIIT IMT-2030 (6G) non‑terrestrial networks working group】The Department of Information and Communication Development at the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) has established the IMT-2030 (6G) promotion group's non‑terrestrial networks (NTN) working group in Beijing. Rupiah Softens After Persistent Decline in Consumer Confidence — The Indonesian rupiah edged lower on Monday, hovering near IDR 17,820 per U.S. dollar after firming to around IDR 17,780 in the prior session. Sentiment was weighed by fresh data showing consumer sentiment fell for a third straight month to a 15-month low in July, amid sustained concerns over current economic conditions and the job outlook. Caution also prevailed ahead of June retail sales data due Tuesday, after sales posted their steepest drop in three years in May due to elevated inflation and higher non-subsidised fuel prices. Still, losses were limited as the U.S. dollar index eased after weaker-than-expected U.S. job data eased bets of further tightening. Locally, foreign investors returned to Indonesian government bonds and equities in July, ending months of sustained selling and providing some support for the rupiah. Traders also remained focused on President Prabowo Subianto’s choice of the next Bank Indonesia governor following Perry Warjiyo’s abrupt departure last month.

China 10Y Yield Returns to 1-Year Low — China’s 10-year government bond yield fell to around 1.70% on Monday, returning to its lowest level since August 2025, as softer inflation data reinforced expectations that Beijing has greater flexibility to provide additional policy support in the remainder of the year. Annual consumer inflation eased to a six-month low of 0.5% in July, reflecting further declines in food prices and slower growth in non-food costs. Producer prices also slowed to 3.5% from 4.1%, marking its first deceleration since turning positive in March following the oil-price surge linked to tensions in the Middle East. At a recent meeting, the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee pledged more proactive and effective macroeconomic policies, faster deployment of fiscal funds and bond proceeds, and continued support for equipment upgrades and consumer goods trade-ins. 【Beijing to start citywide Level-2 flood emergency response on morning of Aug 11】Beijing flood-control office said the city meteorological observatory issued an orange heavy-rain warning on the morning of Aug 10; heavy to very heavy rain is forecast from the evening of Aug 11 through daytime Aug 13. Soybeans Hold Near Multi-Week Lows — Soybean futures held around $11.5 per bushel, staying near five-week lows as traders adjusted positions ahead of the USDA’s upcoming crop report this week. The report will include the first survey-based estimate of 2026 US soybean yields and updated harvested acreage, potentially reshaping expectations for crop size and supplies. Meanwhile, weather has become less supportive, as warmer and drier conditions across parts of the Midwest raised concerns over soybean pod filling during August, adding uncertainty around US yields. While the USDA recently confirmed a private sale of 132,000 metric tons of US soybeans to China for delivery in the 2026/27 marketing year, the purchase did little to offset the bearish supply outlook. Traders now continued to monitor developments in the Black Sea region, where the ongoing Russia-Ukraine war threatened grain export routes, although expectations for another large harvest from the region continued to weigh on prices.

【KDI: Strong semiconductor exports broaden South Korea's economic improvement】The Korea Development Institute (KDI) said in its monthly economic assessment on Monday that South Korea’s recovery is broadening, led by semiconductor-related industries. Exports and equipment investment have maintained strong growth driven by semiconductors, while durable-goods spending is accelerating overall consumption. Services remain solid and manufacturing has rebounded, lifting aggregate industrial production. KDI warned the economy still faces uncertainties from U.S. tariff policy and ongoing Middle East geopolitical instability, and noted elevated inflation and worsening employment are weighing on the recovery.

【China initiates level-4 flood emergency in Hubei, Shandong ahead of Typhoon White Dolphin】The National Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters and the Ministry of Emergency Management initiated a level-4 flood-control emergency response for Hubei and Shandong at 08:00 on Aug 10. Authorities warn of elevated risks of flash floods, geological disasters and flooding on small- and medium-sized rivers.

Indonesia Motorbike Sales Rise 8.3% n July — Motorbike sales in Indonesia grew 8.3% year-on-year to 636,030 units in July 2026, after a 1.1% rise in the previous month. The number was the largest since October 2014, amid easing price pressures in July. For the first seven months of the year, motorbike sales were 2.0% higher than in the same period last year, reaching 3.77 million units. The Association of Indonesian Motorcycle Industry (AISI) expects sales to remain relatively stable at around 6.4 million to 6.7 million units this year. Last year, motorbike sales climbed 1.3% to 6.4 million units, within the target range of 6.4 million to 6.7 million units set by AISI. However, the growth rate was slightly slower than the 1.5% increase recorded in 2024. On a monthly basis, motorbike sales surged 23.0% in July, accelerating sharply from 7.5% growth in June.

【智庫：受晶片產業帶動，韓國經濟正顯現出“全面改善”的跡象】韓國國家智庫週一表示，受晶片相關產業的強勁表現帶動，韓國經濟正顯現出“全面改善”的跡象，但中東地區的不確定性預計將加劇通脹壓力。韓國開發研究院（KDI）在其月度經濟評估報告中指出：“在半導體相關行業的引領下，韓國經濟呈現出全面改善的跡象。”報告補充稱：“在半導體行業的帶動下，出口和裝置投資繼續保持強勁增長；同時，以耐用品消費為主導，消費增速也有所加快。”韓國開發研究院還表示：“隨著服務業保持良好態勢以及製造業的反彈，全行業生產實現了相對較高的增長。”不過，韓國開發研究院也指出，作為亞洲第四大經濟體，韓國仍面臨諸多不確定性，包括美國的關稅政策以及中東地區持續的地緣政治動盪。

【美媒：特朗普傾向對伊朗經濟施壓而非軍事打擊】美國阿克西奧斯新聞網站9日報道稱，美國總統特朗普在接受其採訪時，傾向於對伊朗施加經濟壓力，而非發動新的軍事行動。特朗普在此次簡短電話採訪中表示，“我們正在低調處理此事”。“我們只是與他們（伊朗）進行半正式談判。我們只是在觀望伊朗，他們（面臨）嚴重的通貨膨脹以及沒錢的事實。”他強調，美國的海上封鎖令伊朗的經濟雪上加霜。特朗普還說，隨著油價降至略高於每桶75美元，美國消費者從戰事中感受到的痛苦有所減少。談及與伊朗的反覆博弈，“事情會解決的。它總能解決。這就像下棋一樣”。（新華社）

【里昂：SK海力士股東回報更清晰，維持“高度確信跑贏大市”評級】里昂發表報告指，上週五收市後，SK海力士宣佈積極檢討強化股東價值的措施，並將於第三季度內公佈更多細節。此舉是在投資者對其2026年第二季度財報會議中缺乏明確資本配置指引表達不滿之後出現，而該情況很可能已導致近期股價疲弱。由於至2028年盈利能力與自由現金流非常強勁，該行認為2026年的股東回報可能超過100萬億韓元，將顯著提升股東價值，並可能成為股價重估的催化劑，維持“高度確信跑贏大市”評級，目標價370萬韓元。市場近期對海力士與英偉達的HBM4價格談判有所疑慮，認為其平均售價升幅可能小於同業。據海力士表示，由於核心與基底晶粒採用舊制程生產，其HBM4成本結構顯著低於同業。因此即使價格較低，該行認為海力士仍可能交出優於同業的毛利率。

【美銀：下調申洲國際目標價至50港元，維持“買入”評級】申洲國際預期今年上半年純利同比下跌38%至43%，主要受到人民幣升值、原材料及勞工與退休金成本上升，以及銷量輕微下跌的拖累。美銀證券發表研究報告指，申洲國際中期盈利表現遜於市場預測的下跌30%至35%，相信主要是受到外匯因素的影響。該行目前預測申洲國際中期收入將下跌5%，毛利率料同比收窄逾3個百分點至24%，期內外匯虧損估算達到約6億元，預測政府補助因2025年每股盈利下跌而減少約1億元，綜合預測上半年純利將下跌40%。該行將申洲2026及2027年每股盈利預測分別下調12%及8%，以反映較高的外匯虧損及較低的毛利率，並將目標價從53.2港元下調至50港元，維持“買入”評級。

【招商證券國際：將東方甄選評級由“持有”上調至“買入” 目標價27港元】招商證券國際釋出研報稱，將東方甄選(01797)的投資評級，由“持有”調高至“買入”，維持目標價為27港元。該行認為，東方甄選正穩步轉型為以自有品牌和全通路(Omnichannel)零售為核心的平臺，併成功擺脫對頂級直播主播的依賴。市場目前仍沿用先前的估值框架，尚未充份反映其自有產品的品牌價值或線下零售擴張的潛在價值。

【夏宇任諾安基金董事長】天眼查App顯示，近日，諾安基金管理有限公司發生工商變更，李強卸任法定代表人、董事長，由夏宇接任。該公司成立於2003年12月，註冊資本1.5億人民幣。據媒體報道，此前，該公司公告稱，公司董事長由李強變更為夏宇。

Indonesia Consumer Morale Drops to 15-Month Low — Indonesia’s consumer confidence index fell to 116.8 in July 2026 from 117.8 in the previous month, marking the lowest level since April 2025. The moderation was largely driven by weaker assessments of current economic conditions, which dropped by 1.3 points to 107.9. Sentiment toward durable goods purchases also declined by 1.8 points to 104.1, while perceptions of job availability over the past six months fell by 0.7 points to 101.1. Moreover, expectations for income over the next six months remained steady at 133.6. At the same time, expectations regarding job availability also fell by 1.3 points to 123.1, while expectations for business activity decreased by 0.8 points to 120.4. However, the index remained in optimistic territory, indicating that consumer confidence was still positive, supported by strong perceptions of current economic conditions and favorable expectations for the future.

【EU Copernicus: July global sea surface temperatures reach record high】EU climate-monitoring agency Copernicus Climate Change Service said July global sea surface temperatures hit a record for the month. Average sea surface temperature across non-polar oceans between 60°N and 60°S reached 20.96°C, above the July 2023 record of 20.89°C. Widespread positive SST anomalies are present in the tropical Pacific, where El Niño has developed and is expected to strengthen further in coming months.
【抖音首次開放網暴案例評審】近日，抖音舉辦玩梗式網暴案例研討會。來自法學、心理學、精神醫學、新聞傳播等領域的多位專家學者圍繞玩梗式網路暴力的識別標準、治理邊界與平臺責任展開研討。這是平臺首次引入外部專家參與複雜案例的處置評審，並透明化討論過程。針對公眾人物與公職人員的玩梗治理邊界，多位專家難共識，凸顯治理複雜性。
【歐盟機構：7月全球海洋表面溫度創新高】歐盟氣候監測機構哥白尼氣候變化服務局10日釋出的公報顯示，今年7月全球海洋表面溫度創下有記錄以來同期最高值。公報說，資料顯示，7月南北緯60度之間極地外海域平均海洋表面溫度達到20.96攝氏度，超過2023年7月創下的最高紀錄20.89攝氏度。熱帶太平洋地區大範圍海域水溫異常偏高，厄爾尼諾狀態已在該區域發展，預計未來數月還將進一步增強。（新華社）

【大摩：全球雲資本開支2027年料激增29%，算力飢渴下四大巨頭產能全線告急】摩根士丹利最新發布的全球雲資本支出追蹤報告顯示，全球最大超大規模雲廠商的資本開支並未放緩，預計2027年同比增幅將達29%。摩根士丹利指出，市場對2027年雲資本開支的一致預期為1.2萬億美元，但該預測可能偏保守，實際支出規模或攀升至1.4萬億美元。過去一年，投資者對AI資料中心大規模建設所伴隨的資本開支飆升持續擔憂，給市場帶來一定波動。然而，算力需求始終超出供給，AI商業化變現能力也在持續改善。在此背景下，全球四大超大規模雲廠商中有三家已在2026財年上調資本開支指引：亞馬遜從2000億美元上調至2200億美元；谷歌將指引區間從1800億-1900億美元收窄至1950億-2050億美元；Meta從1250億-1450億美元區間收窄至1300億-1450億美元。微軟則維持1900億美元不變。
【酒類板塊盤中走強 迎駕貢酒漲超6%】酒類板塊盤中走強，迎駕貢酒漲超6%，古井貢酒、會稽山、天佑德酒等股跟漲。

【某頭部雲廠商GPU報價11天零波動 A100/A10全線售罄】SMM瞭解，某頭部雲廠商GPU報價自7月31日至8月10日連續11天維持零變動，覆蓋T4、V100、A10、A100四個型號共200個地域×例項組合，折後價區間穩定在¥1,046.50至¥74,126.65。庫存端呈現"國內緊、海外松"分化格局：上海、南京各斷貨2個（V100及T4/A10），新加坡斷貨2個（T4）；曼谷、香港、東京、阿什本各補貨1個。GT4（A100）16個組合及PNV4（A10）16個組合已連續兩週全線售罄，高階算力供給持續緊張。整體可售記錄數從33降至32（-1），售罄從167升至168（+1），報價體系保持穩定但庫存微幅收緊。（SMM）

【Leading cloud provider GPU prices unchanged for 11 days; A100/A10 listings sold out】A leading cloud provider kept GPU prices unchanged from July 31 to Aug. 10 — 11 consecutive days — across 200 region×instance combinations covering T4, V100, A10 and A100. Discounted prices held in a ¥1,046.50–¥74,126.65 range. Inventory shows a domestic-tight/overseas-loose split: Shanghai and Nanjing each recorded two stockouts (V100 and T4/A10), Singapore logged two T4 stockouts; Bangkok, Hong Kong, Tokyo and Ashburn each replenished one listing. A100 (GT4) 16-combo and A10 (PNV4) 16-combo groups have been fully sold out for two consecutive weeks, signaling continued tightness in high-end compute supply. Available listings fell from 33 to 32 (-1); sold-out listings rose from 167 to 168 (+1).

【與美競爭，歐洲敲定自家“星鏈”規劃】在歐盟委員會於2024年12月宣佈開發Iris2通訊衛星系統一年半之後，這一被視作歐盟版“星鏈”的專案終於完成了談判。當地時間7日，歐盟委員會與該系統設計和運營方SpaceRISE財團完成談判並簽署實施協議。與原定計劃相比，正式簽署的協議新增66顆低地球軌道衛星，使主星座規模達到348顆。歐盟方面表示此舉是對“不斷變化的安全環境”的回應，但德國《南德意志報》等歐洲媒體普遍認為，其另一關鍵目的是提升歐洲在太空領域的主權，避免依賴美國太空探索技術公司（SpaceX）旗下“星鏈”衛星。 歐洲航天局官網資訊顯示，348顆衛星中，330顆將被部署在近地球軌道，另外18顆部署在中地球軌道。據歐盟介紹，其將加快專案開發進度，除衛星製造外，還包括地面基礎設施以及發射服務。歐盟委員會稱，將尋找能為Iris2星座增加“直接向終端裝置傳輸”功能的供應商以提供移動服務，與“星鏈”等同類產品更直接競爭。（環球網）

【Guangdong holds training on 2026 policy financing tools for private firms in Guangzhou】Guangdong Development and Reform Commission, with the Guangdong Federation of Industry and Commerce, held a province-wide training in Guangzhou on new policy financing tools for 2026 aimed at private enterprises. The DRC set out 2026 requirements, priority targets and support areas, and urged local authorities to boost private-firm participation in major projects and convert policy incentives into measurable investment outcomes. Next steps include deepening routine coordination with three policy banks, tracking project applications and approvals across the full cycle, resolving bottlenecks across the project chain, and seeking to include more high-quality private projects in the national project pool to support provincial investment expansion and growth stability.

【上海商超貨架不空供應不斷】颱風白海豚持續影響上海。針對此次颱風天氣帶來的供應波動，上海市農產品市場提前謀劃、備足貨源，各大商超賣場全面啟動極端天氣應急保供預案，加大生活必需品備貨補貨力度。為保障颱風期間蔬菜貨物供應，上海蔬菜集團迅速摸排近期供滬蔬菜主產區種植、採收、庫存及氣象變化情況，8月8日-9日蔬菜和豬肉供應均呈現“量增價穩”的態勢，日均蔬菜週轉總量預計在4000噸以上。在上海閔行區一家商超內，央視財經記者看到，賣場內秩序井然，貨架上商品品類豐富。超市負責人向記者介紹，受颱風影響，門店客流和訂單量都有明顯增加，為了確保貨架不空、供應不斷，門店及時加大了補貨力度。（央視財經）

【亞洲大國央行連續21個月購金7月創階段新高】全球央行購金浪潮仍在持續，亞洲大國央行開啟長達21個月的連續增持週期，即便金價自年初歷史高點回落近30%，依舊堅持戰術性佈局黃金資產。從最新外匯儲備資料可以看到，亞洲大國央行7月黃金增持規模達到20噸，創下2023年10月以來單月最高增持量，自今年3月之後，央行購金的節奏已經明顯加快。

【廣東省新型政策性金融工具培訓視訊會議（民營企業專場）在廣州召開】據廣東省發展改革委訊息，近日，廣東省發展改革委聯合省工商聯舉辦全省新型政策性金融工具培訓視訊會議（民營企業專場）。會上，廣東省發展改革委介紹了2026年新型政策性金融工具的總體要求、重點投向和支援領域，要求各地各部門提高政治站位，充分認識此項工作的重要意義，積極推動廣大民營企業參與重大專案建設，切實把政策紅利轉化為發展實效。下一步，廣東省發展改革委將深化與三家政策性銀行的日常溝通，全週期跟蹤專案申報審批進展，全鏈條協調破解難點堵點，力爭更多優質民營專案納入國家“盤子”，為全省擴投資、穩增長作出新的更大貢獻。
【北京釋出積水內澇橙色預警】北京市水務局與市氣象局2026年8月10日10時00分聯合釋出積水內澇風險橙色預警：預計8月11日20時至13日20時，北京市中心城區存在積水內澇高風險（橙色風險）。請廣大市民關注天氣形勢及雨水情變化，出行儘量避開低窪處，同時做好地下空間防護工作。
